stories.title: Prateek Yadav Death: प्रतीक यादव की मौत से गम में डूबा परिवार, सोशल मीडिया पर अखिलेश को क्यों कोस रहे लोग?
stories.summary: Prateek Yadav Death: समाजवादी पार्टी के संस्थापक मुलायम सिंह यादव (Mulayam Singh Yadav) के छोटे बेटे और अखिलेश यादव के सौतेले भाई प्रतीक यादव (Akhilesh Yadav Brother Prateek Yadav) का बुधवार को निधन हो गया है। आज सुबह लगभग 6 बजे प्रतीक यादव को लखनऊ के सिविल अस्पताल लाया गया था, वहां डॉक्टरों ने उन्हें मृत घोषित कर दिया। प्रतीक की मौत के बाद सोशल मीडिया यूजर्स समाजवादी पार्टी के अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव को कोस रहे हैं।

stories.title: Police Seal Prateek Yadav Room: प्रतीक यादव मौत केस में पुलिस ने सील किया कमरा, मोबाइल और लैपटॉप जब्त
stories.summary: Police Seal Prateek Yadav Room, Laptop-Mobile: समाजवादी पार्टी संस्थापक स्वर्गीय Mulayam Singh Yadav के छोटे बेटे, सपा प्रमुख Akhilesh Yadav के सौतेले भाई और भाजपा नेता Aparna Yadav के पति प्रतीक यादव की संदिग्ध परिस्थितियों में हुई मौत के बाद पुलिस और प्रशासन पूरी तरह सक्रिय हो गया है। बुधवार को लखनऊ के विक्रमादित्य मार्ग स्थित आवास पर पुलिस अधिकारियों और मजिस्ट्रेट की टीम पहुंची और करीब दस मिनट तक पूरे घटनास्थल की पड़ताल की।जांच के दौरान पुलिस ने प्रतीक यादव का कमरा सील कर दिया। साथ ही उनका मोबाइल फोन, लैपटॉप, निजी डायरी और अन्य महत्वपूर्ण सामान कब्जे में ले लिया गया है। पुलिस अब डिजिटल और व्यक्तिगत दस्तावेजों के जरिए मौत से जुड़े हर पहलू की जांच कर रही है। 38 वर्षीय प्रतीक यादव बुधवार सुबह अपने घर में बेहोशी की हालत में मिले थे। उन्हें तुरंत श्यामा प्रसाद मुखर्जी (सिविल) अस्पताल ले जाया गया, जहां डॉक्टरों ने उन्हें मृत घोषित कर दिया।

stories.title: Events before Prateek Yadav’s death:Wife Aparna stayed in touch from Assam, also talked with astrologer
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav's 38-year-old brother Prateek passed away in Lucknow on Wednesday morning. Everyone has been shocked since his sudden death. When Prateek's health deteriorated, his wife Aparna was in Assam at that time. Only Prateek and both daughters were at home. However, as soon as Aparna learned about her husband's deteriorating health, she remained in touch with family members throughout the night. She had also spoken to an astrologer over the phone to help her husband. When did Prateek's health deteriorate? What happened on that last night? Who all were present at home at that time? Read the exclusive report... Astrologer kept checking on him at Aparna's request Sources have revealed that Aparna Yadav was very worried about her husband Pratik's health. She was in Assam, but was taking inputs about his health from time to time. On Tuesday evening around 5 pm, Aparna had called a close family astrologer to help. She had asked him to go home once and check on Pratik's condition. The astrologer could not go himself, but he had contacted a staff member (Rakesh) present at home over the phone. The response was that Pratik was resting in his room. Health deteriorated on Tuesday night at 11:30 PM Sarvesh Pandey, Prateek's gym associate, claims that on Tuesday night around 11:30 PM, Prateek's health suddenly deteriorated. After this, he was taken to Civil Hospital with the help of the driver and staff. Treatment continued there for about an hour, then he went home. However, doctors at Civil Hospital are denying that he was brought to the hospital. Prateek was found unconscious in the kitchen at home It is being reported that on Wednesday morning around 5:30 AM, Prateek was found unconscious in the kitchen of his house. After this, the household servant went to the Civil Hospital and brought the staff back home. Then Prateek was immediately taken to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Civil Hospital CMS Dr. DC Pandey stated that Prateek Yadav was brought to the hospital at 6:55 AM in the morning, but by then he had already died. Prateek's relatives were also present with him. When the doctors examined him, there was no movement in his body. Only the servant and both daughters were at home According to sources, on Tuesday night inside the house were only Prateek, his two daughters Prathama-Pratiksha, and the servant. Security guards were stationed outside. Aparna Yadav had gone to attend the swearing-in ceremony of the Assam government. Due to this, no member of her family was at home. Had not stepped out of home after foot surgery People close to the family say that Prateek Yadav had been at home for the last 3-4 days. In the first week of May, he had undergone surgery on his left foot at a private hospital in Lucknow. Due to this, his going out had stopped. There was considerable swelling in the foot. Prateek was admitted to Medanta Hospital in Lucknow on April 30 before undergoing foot surgery. His condition had improved after 3 days there. After that, he left the hospital and went home without taking discharge. When Akhilesh Yadav went to see BJP leader Anupama Jaiswal at Medanta Hospital, he also met Prateek there, where his treatment was ongoing. Prateek's treatment was being conducted at Medanta Hospital under the supervision of Dr. Rachita Sharma from the Internal Medicine Department. It has also come to light that his routine had changed considerably since the foot operation. He would not meet outsiders at all and would stay in his room only. Heart and viscera preserved During Prateek's postmortem, the heart and viscera were preserved. The purpose of preserving the viscera is to clarify in the investigation whether any kind of poison was administered. However, the postmortem report revealed death due to cardiac arrest. According to the report, a blood clot had traveled from the lower part of his body to the upper part. This affected the arteries and lungs, which led to an infection and death occurred due to cardiac arrest. No external injury marks were found on the body. The bluish discoloration of nails and some body parts is being linked to a recent surgery. Actually, about 2 weeks ago, Pratik had undergone surgery on his left leg. Prateek was battling lung disease for a long time According to doctors, Pratik was suffering from a serious lung disease called pulmonary embolism. He had been battling this disease for a long time. There was a blood clot in his lungs. Apart from this, he was also suffering from depression. What is pulmonary embolism, which caused Prateek's death? According to doctors, Pratik Yadav was suffering from a serious disease like pulmonary embolism (PE). Pulmonary embolism is a life-threatening condition in which a blood clot forms in the arteries of the lungs. This clot often travels to the lungs from Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) that forms in the veins of the legs. Its main symptoms include sudden shortness of breath, sharp chest pain, restlessness and coughing up blood. According to doctors, if timely treatment is not received, this disease proves to be fatal. Know who was Prateek Yadav? Prateek Yadav was the son of SP founder Mulayam Singh Yadav's second wife Sadhana Gupta. Prateek was born on July 7, 1987 in Lucknow. Being Mulayam Singh's son, Prateek's entry into politics was very easy, but he chose a different path from the beginning. Prateek became a successful businessman, fitness freak and maintained a consistent distance from politics. In 2011, Prateek and Aparna had a love marriage.

stories.title: MLA reached by e-rickshaw with gunman in UP:Leaders' rides changed on PM Modi's appeal; some seen by taxi, some by scooter
stories.summary: Amid the global energy crisis, the impact of PM Modi’s appeal is now becoming visible in Uttar Pradesh. At a meeting held at Vikas Bhawan in Meerut on Wednesday, MLC Dharmendra Bhardwaj arrived by e-rickshaw, with his gunner and personal assistant also accompanying him. In a similar gesture, Vineet Sharda, Uttar Pradesh State President of the BJP Vyapar Prakoshth, was seen riding an e-scooter on the road. Meanwhile, Maharajganj Sadar MLA Jai Mangal Kannaujia reached the district headquarters by taxi instead of using a private vehicle. He later held meetings with officials from several departments and listened to public grievances. The developments come a day after Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath urged ministers and MLAs to use public transport at least once a week. See 3 pictures Now, vehicles will be operated in my fleet only as per requirement. No vehicle will be used unnecessarily. National interest is paramount. We all should understand our responsibility and actively contribute to energy saving, environmental protection, and the use of natural resources. MLA reached district headquarters by e-rickshaw Following CM Yogi's appeal to use public transport, Vineet Sharda, UP State President of BJP Vyapar Prakosth (Business Cell), also traveled around Meerut on an e-scooty. Vineet Sharda said that he will now regularly do public outreach in the city using this scooty. This scooty belongs to his son, which he will drive from today. Maharajganj Sadar MLA Jai Mangal Kannaujia reached the district headquarters by taxi, leaving his private car. The MLA held a meeting with officials from various departments at the district headquarters and resolved people's problems. MLA Jai Mangal Kannaujia said - The whole world is currently facing the challenge of an energy crisis. Due to increasing tension between Israel, America, and Iran, the international supply of crude oil is affected, which is impacting many countries including India. He said that reducing the consumption of petrol and diesel is the need of the hour. Every citizen should come forward for energy conservation. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath are continuously appealing to people for the judicious use of resources. I myself have decided to travel by taxi instead of using a private vehicle. So that the public can be given the message that big changes are possible even with small initiatives. The MLA appealed to people to avoid unnecessary use of vehicles, promote public transport, and save fuel. A day earlier, the Minister of State returned the escort vehicles Minister of State Dinesh Khatik also returned his escort vehicles, following PM Modi's appeal. He said that now he will travel by bike or train with the aim of saving fuel and reducing government expenditure. Along with this, he also halved the security of his residence. He said that doing so will not only reduce government expenditure but also promote fuel conservation. PM Modi said for 2 consecutive days - reduce the use of petrol-diesel Prime Minister Narendra Modi said from a public platform on May 10 and 11 that in today's time, the use of petrol-diesel and gas will have to be reduced. Due to the impact of the ongoing war in the neighborhood, petrol-diesel prices have increased many times worldwide. India is more affected by this global crisis. We do not have large oil wells. Today we need measures like work from home. In cities with metros, people should use the metro. He said that earlier, during wars, people used to donate gold. Today there is no need for donations, but today we have to take a pledge that for the next 1 year, whatever the occasion, do not buy gold. This will also save foreign exchange. 5 Big Points of PM Modi

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Akhilesh Yadav's brother Prateek passes away; Vijay wins floor test with 144 votes after AIADMK split-vote
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Vijay wins floor test with 144 votes after AIADMK split-vote Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay passed his first hurdle in the Tamil Nadu Assembly, winning the trust vote on the floor of the House with 144 ‘ayes’. Meanwhile, 22 MLAs went against the confidence motion, and five abstained. 2. Akhilesh Yadav's brother Prateek passes away in Lucknow: SP chief mourns loss Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav’s brother Prateek Yadav died on Wednesday. He was 38 years old. Around 6 am, he was taken to Lucknow’s Civil Hospital by Aman Singh Bisht, the brother of his wife Aparna Yadav, where doctors declared him dead. According to Civil Hospital CMS, Dr. DC Pandey, Prateek’s pulse had completely stopped when he was brought in, and his heart was no longer functioning. 3. Maharashtra govt likes Kashi Vishwanath Temple's SOP: Officials reach Kashi to conduct study The Maharashtra government is considering implementing the pilgrimage management expertise of the Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple Trust for the upcoming Simhasth Kumbh Mela to be held on the banks of the Godavari River in Nashik. Officials expect approximately 12 crore devotees to participate in this event. 4. Tehran confirms Araghchi's visit to India for BRICS FMs meet In an official post on X, the Iranian Embassy in India confirmed that the Foreign Minister of Iran, Seyed Abbas Araghchi, will travel to India to attend the Foreign Ministers' meeting of BRICS member countries. Additionally, the Iranian FM will hold discussions and exchange views with EAM Jaishankar. 5. Psycho killer had planned to murder 7 more: Kills 3 within 25 hrs before encounter Ex-Army personnel Gurpreet Singh, described by police as a “psycho killer,” had allegedly planned to murder 7 more people before he was killed in a police encounter after reportedly snatching a police officer’s pistol and trying to flee during a crime scene recreation. 6. Dumper runs over several vehicles in Lucknow: Man’s leg severed, 4 injured In Lucknow on Wednesday morning, an out-of-control dumper crushed 4 vehicles. It ran over an e-auto loading passengers, a CNG auto, a car, and a bike. All vehicles were damaged. In the accident, 4 people including the drivers of these vehicles were seriously injured. A young man's left leg was severed and stuck to the divider. A government teacher going to school had her right leg broken. 7. 'India has 60 days of crude, 45 days of LPG,' says Petroleum Minister Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri said on Tuesday that India currently has reserves of 60 days of crude oil, 60 days of LNG and 45 days of LPG. He said there is no issue with supply. Speaking at the CII Annual Business Summit in Delhi, Puri also referred to Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s recent appeal to save resources. 8. STF guns down Zubair in AMU teacher murder case The STF shot down Zubair, accused of murdering a teacher at Aligarh Muslim University, in Meerut on Wednesday at 4 AM. SP Brijesh Kumar Singh stated that they had received information that Zubair had come to Meerut to commit a murder. He was hiding in a closed factory and waiting for his associates. 9. Gorakhpur Police busts 'Luteri Dulhan' racket The Gorakhpur Police have arrested the absconding bride involved in a fake marriage and extortion racket that targeted unmarried men from other states. The accused, identified as Neelam Singh, was arrested from the Ramgarhtal area days after seven members of the gang, including a history-sheeter, were sent to jail. 10. Gold, silver prices surge after govt raises import duty to 15% The government has increased the import duty of gold and silver from 6% to 15%, making these metals costlier by ₹10,000 and ₹18,000, respectively, in the futures market (MCX). Currently, the price of 10 grams of gold is ₹1.60 lakh, while 1 kg of silver costs ₹2.97 lakh.

stories.title: In-laws shocked by Prateek Yadav's death:Aparna's brother says, 'Family suffered injustice; the entire matter should be investigated'
stories.summary: When the news of the death of Prateek Yadav, brother of SP chief Akhilesh Yadav and husband of BJP leader Aparna Yadav, reached Garhbarsali (Kura) village in Dunda block of Uttarkashi on Wednesday, a wave of grief swept through the entire area. People in the village initially couldn't believe that such a major tragedy had occurred in the family of their "daughter" Aparna Yadav. Villagers say that as the news of the death spread, people started calling each other to gather information. Many people are waiting for the postmortem report. Among the local people, there is shock along with sadness regarding the incident. Garhbarsali village is Aparna Yadav's ancestral village. Her ancestral home still exists here today. According to villagers, Aparna has maintained her connection with the village and has been visiting here from time to time. In such circumstances, the news of Prateek Yadav's death has left the entire region in deep shock. Cousin brother said - The whole village is hurt by the news Aparna Yadav's cousin brother and lawyer by profession Anoop Singh Bisht said that the whole village is saddened by the news that has come out. He said, "We are very hurt by this incident. There is an atmosphere of mourning in the village too. We pray to God to give peace to the departed soul and give the family strength to bear the grief." He told that Aparna Yadav's attachment to the village always remained. She used to come here from time to time and stayed connected with the village people. Anoop Singh said that when they last met, everything seemed normal. He never felt any kind of discord regarding family relationships. People said- How could this happen to the daughter People living in the village say that when they received the news of Prateek Yadav's demise, initially no one could believe it. Local people said that everyone in the village is asking how such a big tragedy could happen. According to villagers, Aparna Yadav is still seen as "our daughter" in the village. This is why there is an atmosphere of mourning throughout the Barsali area after the news of the incident. Many people are continuously watching updates on TV and mobile and are waiting for the postmortem report to come. Caretaker said- Aparna had very good behavior Sonu Kashyap, the caretaker who looks after Aparna Yadav's ancestral home, said that he too came to know about the incident later. He said that whenever Aparna Yadav came to the village, she met everyone with good behavior. Sonu said that he is also very sorry about this sad incident. People in the village are continuously discussing this matter. However, no information has been received yet from the family about any program in the village. Villagers said- We are with the family in this hour of grief Another relative from the village told that Aparna Yadav lived in Lucknow since childhood, but her connection with the village remained. She used to come here for family functions and religious ceremonies. He said that people from the entire area are standing with the family in this hour of grief. Relatives say that information about Prateek Yadav's deteriorating health had also been received a month ago. Now after the news of death, everyone in the village is stunned.

stories.title: Former MLA Vijay Mishra sentenced to life imprisonment:Murdered lawyer's brother in court; verdict came after 46 years
stories.summary: The Prayagraj Court has delivered a major verdict in a 46-year-old murder case linked to former strongman MLA Vijay Mishra. The MP-MLA Special Court has sentenced all four accused, including Vijay Mishra, to rigorous life imprisonment. MP-MLA Special Court Judge Yogesh Kumar III sentenced all the accused to rigorous life imprisonment and a fine of one lakh rupees each under Section 302 of the IPC. Additionally, under Section 307 of the IPC, they were sentenced to 10 years imprisonment each and a fine of 50,000 rupees each. Apart from Vijay Mishra, the court also convicted Jeet Narayan, Santram Mishra, and Balram Mishra, awarding them similar sentences. The court had declared all four accused guilty just a day earlier. This case dates back to February 11, 1980, when 35-year-old Prakash Narayan Pandey was shot dead in the court premises. Following the incident, the deceased's elder brother Shyam Narayan Pandey had filed a murder case at Colonelganj police station. Vijay Mishra is already imprisoned in Agra jail, while the other three accused were out on bail. After being convicted by the court, all three were taken into custody and sent to jail. Security arrangements were extremely tight during the pronouncement of the verdict. Vijay Mishra was brought to the court premises under heavy security. A large police force was also deployed outside the MP-MLA Special Court. Vijay Mishra sentenced to life imprisonment in this case At Karnalganj police station, Shyam Narayan Pandey, a resident of Hathi Gaon Nawabganj, had filed a First Information Report on February 11, 1980, stating that he had come to the court to arrange bail in a case. He was sitting at his lawyer's seat, which is at Chhote Lal's hotel in the court premises. Just then, Vijay Mishra, Balram Santram, and Jeet Narayan came with guns and rifles and shot Prakash Narayan Pandey. This resulted in his death. The police had also recovered a gun from the scene of the incident. The court recorded Shyam Narayan Pandey's statement under oath. Former MLA Vijay Mishra is currently lodged in Agra jail. He was presented in the entire proceedings through video conferencing. Former MLA Vijay Mishra brought under tight security Former MLA Mishra is scheduled to be sentenced on Wednesday. In view of this, Vijay Mishra will be brought to the court premises in the afternoon amid tight security arrangements. On Tuesday, on court orders, former MLA Vijay Mishra, who is lodged in Agra jail, was presented in court. The other three accused appeared in court on bail. After conviction, the court took all the accused including Vijay Mishra into judicial custody and sent them to Naini Central Jail. Assistant District Government Advocate Sushil Vaishya said that eight witnesses were presented in court on behalf of the prosecution. Based on their statements and evidence, the court convicted all four accused. The 87 previous cases registered against Vijay Mishra were also presented before the court. Dozens of cases against mafia Vijay Mishra There are more than 77 cases against Vijay Mishra including murder, attempt to murder, Arms Act, Gangster Act, Goonda Act, kidnapping, and Mineral Act. These include cases in Prayagraj's Georgetown, Handia, Utarao, Sarai Mamrej, Phulpur, Kotwali, Civil Lines, Varanasi's Bhelupur, Bhadohi, Gopiganj, Aurai, Koirauna, Gyanpur, Mirzapur's Kotwali Dehat, Vindhyachal and Meerut and Shivpur Howrah. Vijay Mishra has been acquitted in several cases while final reports have been filed in some. Investigation is still ongoing in many cases and some cases are also on trial in court.

stories.title: Akhilesh hints at Prateek’s financial troubles:Real estate crores stuck; kin removed from office
stories.summary: After the death of younger brother Prateek Yadav, Akhilesh Yadav reached the postmortem house of KGMU in Lucknow. He said- I had met Prateek 2 months ago. At that time I had told him to take care of his health. To grow his business. Sometimes the losses that occur in business can break a person completely. What is the business loss that Akhilesh emotionally mentioned? We asked this question to people very close to SP and the Yadav family. It emerged that Prateek was doing business in real estate and the fitness industry. Aparna Yadav's brother Aman Bisht was a partner in his companies. However, in the last 1 year, there had been considerable losses from different investments. Due to this, Prateek had become very angry with Aman. He had even asked him to vacate the office of his gym 'Iron Core Fit'. This gym is located at Manoj Pandey Chauraha in Gomti Nagar. After this, Pratik had been a bit worried. However, Aman Bisht was seen with Pratik in the ambulance at the Civil Hospital. He was also present at the postmortem house. First understand Pratik's business He ran a real estate business with the help of Aparna's brother Pratik was doing business in two sectors. First- Real Estate. Second- Fitness Industry. To manage the real estate business, Pratik took the help of his wife Aparna Yadav's brother Aman Singh Bisht. After the SP government was formed in UP in 2012, Aman registered 17 companies. In these, from July 12, 2012 to April 29, 2016, Aman was appointed as Director or Designated Director in a total of 16 companies. In another company, Aman was appointed as Director on May 1, 2018. Most of these companies were registered as real estate businesses. However, even though Aman was the Director, the reins of the entire business remained in the hands of Prateek Yadav. Now know about the business dispute... FIR filed against businessman, Prateek's allegation - demanding extortion of Rs 5 crore A close friend of Prateek told on condition of anonymity - In 2017, SP lost power. After that, arguments started between Aman and Prateek over profit and loss in business. How big this loss was, was never mentioned. Pratik also had a dispute with Krishnanand, a partner in the real estate business. Pratik had invested several crores with Krishnanand. When Pratik asked for his money back, Krishnanand started threatening to trap him in a fake case. Last year, the dispute escalated so much that Krishnanand filed a complaint against Pratik with the police. When the police investigated, the matter turned out to be completely opposite. Then, on behalf of Pratik, an FIR was registered at Gautampalli police station in Lucknow on July 13, 2025. In this, there was a complaint against Krishnanand Pandey, his wife Vandana Pandey, and father Ashok Pandey for defrauding 4-5 crores and demanding extortion of 5 crores. The police investigation in this matter is still ongoing. FIR was also filed against Aparna's brother On September 20, 2025, Thakur Singh had also filed a fraud case against Aman Bisht. Allegations of embezzlement of 14 crore rupees were made in this. This case was registered on court orders. Aman was accused that in 2019, he took money from businessman Thakur Singh claiming to sell approximately 22 bighas of land in Sarasawa and Ahmau villages of Sarojininagar. But, the deal was not completed. The money was transferred to the account of Aman Singh Bisht's company Monal Infraheights. Investigation of this is also ongoing. Money sunk in Noida too, Pratik went into depression Sources reveal that Pratik had invested several crores with a businessman in Noida as well. The businessman with whom the money was invested turned dishonest. He refused to return Pratik's money. After this, Pratik had been continuously living in depression. Sources also say that Pratik had made plans to shift to England with both his daughters. However, before that, he was trying to collect the money invested in the business.

stories.title: Husband hangs self, pregnant wife dies by suicide:Couple had love marriage 5 months ago in Gorakhpur
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, a husband and wife committed suicide 5 months after their love marriage. The husband's body was found hanging from a fan in the room while the wife's body was lying on the bed. Foam was coming out of her mouth. The young woman was pregnant. On Tuesday morning, when the room's door didn't open for a long time, the sister raised an alarm. Neighbors gathered. Police were called. When they broke open the door and went inside, they came to know. The case is from Belghat police station area. The reason for suicide has not yet come to light. According to police, the reason will only become clear after the postmortem report comes. See 2 pictures... Know the complete matter Shadab (25) of Mukarippur village had a love marriage in November 2025 with Nikhat Nisha (24), daughter of Nisar Ahmad, also a resident of the same village. Shadab's father Tasavvur lives in Dubai while his mother Najeebun lives in the village. Shadab was fourth among 2 brothers and four sisters. While wife Nikhat's father does business in Mumbai, Shadab used to live in the village. He did not do any work. According to family members, the wife was pregnant. There had been a dispute between husband and wife over some matter for the past week. Shadab's mother Najeebun Nisha said that on Monday evening both husband and wife were sitting separately in a sad mood. When asked, they did not give any answer. After this, they had dinner and went to sleep. On Tuesday morning, when the door did not open for a long time, daughter Sumaiya called out but got no response. On suspicion, she peeked through the window of the room and screamed after seeing the scene inside. Shadab's body was hanging from the fan in the room, while Nikhat Nisha was lying unconscious. Foam was coming out of her mouth. Hearing the noise, people from nearby reached the spot and broke open the door and entered. On receiving information, Belghat police also reached the spot. According to police, preliminary investigation has revealed that Nikhat had consumed a poisonous substance, while Shadab took his life by hanging. However, the exact cause of death will be clear only after the postmortem report comes. Wife was unable to adjust in the village According to relatives, Nikhat's entire family lives in Mumbai. She too has been living in Mumbai since childhood. After marriage, she was unable to adjust to the village environment. Neighbors said - due to this reason, differences between the two started increasing. Shadab was also not doing anything and was unemployed. He was also under financial pressure. Meanwhile, the police examined both their mobiles. During the investigation, messages from the young woman were found which stated that you don't take me anywhere for outings, you don't fulfill any of my needs. To this, husband Shadab's reply was that such things don't work in our community. Nikhat was the daughter of Shadab's aunt In the police investigation, it came to light that Nikhat was Shadab's aunt's daughter. As they visited each other's homes, love developed between them. After this, with the family's consent, both of them got married (nikah). SP South Dinesh Puri stated- The bodies of a husband and wife have been found inside a house. Both are suspected to have committed suicide. No injury marks were found on the bodies. Both bodies have been sent for post-mortem.

stories.title: Dumper runs over several vehicles in Lucknow:Man’s leg severed, 4 injured; government teacher suffers fractured leg
stories.summary: In Lucknow on Wednesday morning, an out-of-control dumper crushed 4 vehicles. It ran over an e-auto loading passengers, a CNG auto, a car, and a bike. All vehicles were damaged. In the accident, 4 people including the drivers of these vehicles were seriously injured. A young man's left leg was severed and stuck to the divider. A government teacher going to school had her right leg broken. The accident occurred at Chandra Dhal, about 200 meters away from Madiyaon police station. Some auto drivers were loading passengers on the service lane of Lucknow-Sitapur Road under the flyover. There are tea and water shops there. Around 7 AM, a dumper left the main road and entered the service lane. It hit an auto. Then a woman collided with the auto and fell 10 feet away. A young man was also standing there on a bike. He got caught between the truck and the divider. This caused his left leg to be severed. Due to losing one leg, he was unable to get up. During this entire sequence of events, the dumper's driver and helper got down and fled. Police, with the help of local people and passersby, pulled out the injured trapped under the vehicles. Look at 5 pictures- 4 people injured including government teacher After the accident, Civil Defense volunteers also reached the spot along with the police. People were writhing and groaning on the road. A rescue operation was launched and they were sent to the hospital by ambulance. Damaged vehicles were being removed from the road. Ashu Gautam (26), son of Ramkhelawan from Bharatnagar in Madiyaon, had his left leg completely severed. Abhay Kumar Singh (22), son of Mohan Singh from Ghodadeur Pipraich in Kushinagar district, is in critical condition. Government teacher Nidhi (28), both auto drivers Pankaj (40) and Shyam Sundar (49) were also injured. Auto driver Pankaj was taken away by his family members. The owner of the damaged car, Vikuljeet, had gotten off and walked a short distance just before the accident, which saved him. Government teacher's father is SI at the police station Government teacher Nidhi's right leg was broken in this accident. She is posted in Sitapur. Her husband is a government teacher in Lakhimpur Kheri. She had a daughter 2 months ago. Nidhi's father Anil Singh is posted as SI in Chinhat police station. Police removed the leg after 45 minutes Anand, younger brother of seriously injured Ashu (30), said that he had come to drop him off for duty. As soon as he got off the bike and turned to sit in the auto, a dumper hit him from behind. His brother's leg came under the bike and was severed. After about 45 minutes, the police removed his brother's leg. Eyewitnesses said - No one got a chance to recover Eyewitness Pawan Kumar said - The dumper came so fast that no one got a chance to recover. The dumper ran over the bike and auto and went away. The 3 people sitting in the auto, the youth riding the bike and some people who were standing outside close to the vehicles, all came under the dumper. Nabi Hasan, who was involved in rescue operations with the police, said- As soon as we got the information, we all rushed to the spot. The accident occurred either due to the driver dozing off or the dumper's brake failure. In the accident, the auto driver, a youth riding a bike and a woman were seriously injured. More than a dozen people have been taken to the hospital. Injured sent to Trauma Center Madiyaon Station House Officer Shivanand Mishra informed that the information was received at 7:15 AM. One seriously injured person has been sent to KGMU Trauma Center. Another has been sent to Janakipuram Trauma Center. A total of 4 people were injured, of which the police is extracting details of one person named Pankaj. The driver of the dumper (UP 78 JT 3673) is being searched for.

stories.title: Temples should be free from govt control- Narendranand Saraswati:Says, 'Each Hindu should have 1 cow, who wanted to eliminate Sanatan has expired'
stories.summary: Sumeru Peethadhishwar Shankaracharya Narendranand Saraswati has given a major statement on the current social and religious issues of the country. During the saints' conference at the Foundation Day program, he openly expressed his views on topics such as religious conversion, Uniform Civil Code, control of temples, and global crisis. India should remain united Swami Narendranand Saraswati said - India should remain united, secure and protected. On the 35th Foundation Day of Brahmaleen Shankaracharya Shankaranand Saraswati Ji, the Mahaabhishek and Chakrarchan of Chandramauleshwar and Tripura Sundari were completed. After this, a saints' conference was held, in which the burning issues of the country were discussed. Uniform education policy UCC are the need of the hour Religious conversion, which is a kind of national conversion, is not in the interest of the country. Control of temples should be in the hands of Hindus rather than the government. Uniform education policy and Uniform Civil Code are the need of the hour. The work of saints is to awaken dharma. If society becomes aware, then cow protection will also happen and a healthy society will be built. Saints supported the Prime Minister's appeal Swami Narendranand Saraswati said - Gold is anyway considered the abode of Kaliyuga, which creates unrest. Crimes also increase due to gold, people even lose their lives. Therefore, as far as possible, limited use of gold and modern resources should be made. The appeal made by the Prime Minister during the global crisis is in the interest of the nation and the public should follow it. Those who wanted to destroy Sanatan, been destroyed Narendranand Saraswati said that among our 14 vidyas (branches of knowledge), astrology is also an important vidya, which has been called the eye. If astrologers are advisors, they will provide good guidance. Those who were talking about ending Sanatan have themselves ended. Vijay's coming is in the interest of the nation, the country and humanity.

stories.title: Muslim boy trapped, married and blackmailed me, girl to Aniruddhacharya:Says, 'He demanded money beat me'; MLA flags to SP, police arrest accused
stories.summary: A female student from Deoria shared her ordeal of an affair and blackmailing at storyteller Aniruddhacharya's public discourse. The student revealed that at the age of 14, a Muslim youth trapped her in a love affair. He went with her to a temple and married her. After that, the youth would demand money and beat her when she refused. On this, Aniruddhacharya said that this is ‘meetha balatkar’ (sweet rape) and young women should be very cautious of such cases. The student's video went viral on social media. Following this, MLA Shalabhmani Tripathi wrote a letter to the SP demanding action. On May 10, the student's mother filed a complaint at Bariyarpur police station. The police registered a case and arrested the accused on Tuesday and sent him to jail. First read the conversation between Aniruddhacharya and the student... Girl- Radhe-Radhe Guruji. Aniruddhacharya- Who do you love? Girl- He is not a boy from our caste, he is Muslim. I have been in love for two years. Aniruddhacharya- What is your age? Girl- My age is 16 years. He is 18 years old. The love has been going on since I was 14 years old. His house is near the crossroads of our village. Aniruddhacharya- What is his name? Girl- Ashiq Ansari. Aniruddhacharya- Do you people meet? Girl- No, he used to study with me in school. We used to go out before, but haven't been going for a year, we just talk. Aniruddhacharya- That boy is older than you. He is trying to trap young girls. Aniruddhacharya- Your mother was telling me that you had given him money. How much money did you give? Girl- I had given ₹29,000. Aniruddhacharya- Think about it, you are stealing your mother's money and giving it to him. One needs to be very careful in such matters. He can later do love jihad with you. He can even take you to another state and sell you. There people will misbehave with you. Child, study well and make your parents proud. Aniruddhacharya- Are you studying? Girl- I failed in high school. Aniruddhacharya- If you fall in love before time, studies will be affected. Who started the conversation? Girl- He started it. I used to go to school, we became friends there and started talking. Aniruddhacharya- This is what Muslims do. They befriend Hindu girls and they sexually exploit them. Tell me, did he rape this girl or not. He is 18 years old and she is 16 years old. There are two types of rape - one by force and one by brainwashing. These people should be prosecuted. Daughters, what you are experiencing is called love jihad. How many girls like you are being exploited. It has happened before too. Tell us, what do you want to say to other girls? Girl- Guruji, I wasn't like this, I used to live with my friend. My friends also used to talk to Muslim boys. Aniruddhacharya- Think about how love jihad has infiltrated at the ground level. 15-16 year old girls don't have awareness, so Muslims trap and keep them. By the time they turn 18, they become completely devoted to them. Then they are taken abroad and sold. Girl- The girls who were in class, all of them used to talk to Muslim boys. Aniruddhacharya- Is the school government or private? Girl- No, it's private. The school also belongs to Yadav. Aniruddhacharya- Brothers, I request the Yadavs to be aware of where you are sending your daughters. Now this girl has been exploited. When you know that the girls of your school are involved with Muslims. The school authorities are also responsible for this, aren't they? This is sweet rape. Girl's mother- Guruji, she says that she has done wrong things with that boy thousands of times. Aniruddhacharya- How many girls are there in the school? Girl- Three to four hundred. Aniruddhacharya- And how many boys are there? Girl- All are Muslims only. Aniruddhacharya- How many are Hindus? Girl- There aren't many, just 10-20. Aniruddhacharya- Muslim boys have the excuse of studying, but their real aim is to trap Hindu girls. Aniruddhacharya- My sister, you tell me, what you did with that boy, was it right or wrong? Girl- It was wrong. Aniruddhacharya- Now you have to become a Hindu lioness. You have to save your sisters and daughters. You have to make people aware. Tell them that I have already been trapped. Don't let yourselves get trapped. You have to become doctors and engineers. He is a jihadist, he will do exactly this. Aniruddhacharya- Now tell me, is this your fault or his? Girl- It's my fault. Aniruddhacharya- Make your girls like the sun, so that no one can even look at them. You tell me sister, what should daughters do? Girl- I would say that no boy or girl should do all this. Guruji, he took me to the temple and married me. He used to say- we don't go to temples. We are going only for you. He used to ask for money, when I didn't give it, he wouldn't even talk to me. When I didn't give money, he even beat me. Aniruddhacharya- No matter how much anyone says that my Abdul is not like that, your Abdul is exactly like that. Girl- Guruji, when I tell my friends, they say that yours was like that. Ours is not like that. Mother- Guruji, she has given him a mobile phone worth ten thousand. She says that she will give her life for him. Accused sent to jail on mother's complaint This video of the conversation between Aniruddhacharya and the girl appeared on social media. On the complaint of the student's mother, the police registered a case against the accused. After investigation, the police arrested the accused Aashiq Ansari and presented him in court. From where he was sent to jail in judicial custody. MLA Shalabh Mani says, ‘Will give them due punushment’ Sadar MLA Dr. Shalabh Mani Tripathi said that strict action should be taken against such jihadis. He wrote in a Facebook post, “The jihadi lover Ashiq Ansari who committed brutality with a minor Hindu girl in Bharauta, Devariya has been traced with the cooperation of all of you, Under the leadership of SP Abhijit R Shankar, Deoria Police has shown promptness and caught this beast. Those who cast evil eyes on Hindu sisters and daughters will be treated properly,” he said.

stories.title: 40 teachers absent in inspection of 27 schools:Several schools found closed, Chief Development Officer conducted inspection
stories.summary: The negligence of Basic Education Department schools in Agra was exposed during a surprise inspection. Following the instructions of District Magistrate Manish Bansal, Chief Development Officer Pratibha Singh conducted inspections of primary and junior schools across the district. During the inspection, 40 teachers were found absent in 27 schools, while several schools were not even open. Taking the matter seriously, the administration has ordered strict action, including suspension, salary deduction, and adverse entries. BDOs and ADOs conducted surprise inspections of schools in various development blocks of the district. The inspection found very low teacher attendance in several schools in Etmadpur, Bah, Fatehabad, Bichpuri, and Shamshabad blocks. At some places, students were present, but teachers had not arrived. Meanwhile, several schools in Akola, Jagner, Jaitpur Kalan, and Fatehabad blocks were found closed. Administrative officers have termed this as serious negligence in the education system. After the inspection report came to light, on the instructions of the District Magistrate, the Chief Development Officer was directed to initiate action to suspend the headmasters of schools found closed with immediate effect. Along with this, it has been asked to deduct the salary of May 12 for teachers found absent without prior permission. Instructions have also been issued to give adverse entries to the concerned Block Education Officers (BEO). During the investigation, not only teacher attendance but also many shortcomings in arrangements related to education came to light. In many schools, the distribution of textbooks and workbooks to students was found to be incomplete. The use of Teaching-Learning Material (TLM) and teacher handbooks was also not found satisfactory. Officials acknowledged that a lot of work still needs to be done to improve the academic quality in schools. The DM has ordered an investigation into the matter and action as per the rules. It has also been asked to issue a notice to the Basic Shiksha Adhikari (BSA). The administration has made it clear that such inspection campaigns will continue in the future to ensure regular attendance, quality teaching, and timely operation in schools.

stories.summary: The Maharashtra government is considering implementing the pilgrimage management expertise of the Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple Trust for the upcoming Simhasth Kumbh Mela to be held on the banks of the Godavari River in Nashik. Officials expect approximately 12 crore devotees to participate in this event. As part of these preparations, the state government is exploring ways to leverage the experience of developing the temple's Trimbakeshwar Corridor. The Shri Kashi Vishwanath Special Area Development Board provides its services to major temples and religious events on demand. Nashik officials had visited Kashi Vishwanath Temple According to sources, several government officials responsible for preparations had visited Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple last month to study the management model. The state government is considering adopting the board's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the Nashik gathering along the same lines. The Kashi model has been praised for the seamless management of crores of devotees since its inauguration. The delegation focused on learning expertise in crowd management, real-time CCTV surveillance, zone-based control, and app-based token system. Officials had visited, assistance will be provided once the proposal is passed Chief Executive Officer Vishwa Bhushan Mishra said - Officials from Nashik who came from Trimbakeshwar had studied the arrangements here some time ago. We have not yet officially received their proposal. Maharashtra media has published this. Upon receiving the proposal, Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple Trust and Shri Kashi Vishwanath Special Area Development Authority will gladly provide services to other institutions regarding consultancy and execution services as per the procedure approved by the board. stories.title: Opposition's protest against PM's appeal:Kanpur BJP Regional President says, 'Oppn parties are spreading confusion and fear among public'
stories.summary: Politics has intensified over Prime Minister Narendra Modi's appeal to the public to buy less gold and use fuel only as per necessity. In Kanpur, too, Congress and SP staged protests over this. BJP has accused the opposition of misleading the public by presenting this issue incorrectly. BJP Kanpur-Bundelkhand region president Prakash Pal said that this appeal by the Prime Minister is in the national interest and to keep the economy strong. He said that during times of economic challenges, governments have always sought cooperation from the public. Such appeals have been made before too Prakash Pal said that this is not the first time. In 1967, the then Prime Minister Indira Gandhi had also made such an appeal in the national interest. Similarly, in 2013, during the Congress government, the then Finance Minister P. Chidambaram had asked people to buy less gold. At that time, decisions were also taken to keep petrol pumps closed from 8 PM to 8 AM to control petrol-diesel consumption. He said, targeting Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav, that the opposition is more interested in anti-Modi politics than national interest. If the opposition has any concrete suggestions to deal with economic challenges, they should present them before the country. The BJP leader said that it is the duty of a responsible government to make the public aware before a potential economic crisis. But instead of providing solutions, the opposition is creating an atmosphere of fear and confusion. He claimed that the people of the country have understood the opposition's politics and stand with Prime Minister Modi in the national interest.

stories.title: KDA's bulldozer runs over 66 bigha illegal plotting:4 JCBs conducted action for 3:45 hours in Fattepur area, 6 illegal plotting identified
stories.summary: Kanpur Development Authority (KDA) took major action in Zone-3 on Wednesday, running bulldozers over illegal plotting being developed on approximately 66 bighas of land. The demolition drive was carried out continuously for 3 hours and 45 minutes with the help of 4 JCBs. During this, roads, drains, boundary walls, electricity poles, pillars, entry gates, sewer lines, and several under-construction buildings were demolished. The action was carried out in the Fattepur area under the leadership of Special Executive Officer/Additional District Magistrate of Enforcement Zone 3, Dr. Ravi Pratap Singh. Plotting was being done in different plots According to KDA officials, Manoj Singh Bhadauria and others were developing illegal plotting on approximately 66 bighas across several land parcels in the Fattepur area without getting the map approved by the authority. The authority's team reached the spot and demolished the entire plotting. Officials stated that plotting and construction work were being carried out without permission, and action was taken as per the rules. 6 more illegal plottings identified Dr. Ravi Pratap Singh informed that 6 other illegal plottings have also been identified in Enforcement Zone-3. If satisfactory responses are not received within the stipulated time frame, sealing and demolition action will be taken against these as well. These include areas of Bingawan, Tikapur, Ramaipur, Bidhnu (Suraj Nagar), and Sen West Para. Illegal plotting ranging from 2000 square meters to 36 thousand square meters is being developed in these areas. Appeal to people, buy plots only after verification KDA has appealed to the general public that before purchasing any plot in the authority area, they must obtain information from the authority itself, whether the layout is approved or not. Also, ensure that the map is approved before building construction and that construction is done accordingly, so that financial and mental losses can be avoided in the future. Officials have clarified that this campaign against illegal construction and plotting will continue in the future as well.

stories.title: Gorakhpur Police busts 'Luteri Dulhan' racket:Fake wedding gang held Rajasthan family hostage and looted lakhs
stories.summary: The Gorakhpur Police have arrested the absconding bride involved in a fake marriage and extortion racket that targeted unmarried men from other states. The accused, identified as Neelam Singh, was arrested from the Ramgarhtal area days after seven members of the gang, including a history-sheeter, were sent to jail. Police said the gang arranged sham weddings, held grooms and their relatives hostage by posing as police personnel, and extorted huge sums of money. The racket came to light after a Rajasthan family complained of being looted during a marriage ceremony in Gorakhpur. Bride lived under fake identity Investigators said Neelam Singh, a resident of Ballia district, had been living in Gorakhpur’s Rustampur Rajiv Nagar Colony for nearly two years. She allegedly introduced herself as “Rekha” while working with the gang. Police said she was separated from her husband and had earlier worked with an NGO involved in women’s health awareness campaigns. To avoid suspicion, she reportedly told her landlord she worked in a mall. During this period, she came in contact with Shaila Devi, linked to the gang of history-sheeter Ankur Singh. The duo allegedly began trapping men through fake marriage deals for quick money. Fake inspector led extortion plot Police said Ankur Singh, a notorious history-sheeter from Chiluatal, masterminded the operation. The gang allegedly created an entire fake police setup: Ankur posed as a police inspector Four associates acted as constables and head constables Women were recruited to pose as brides and relatives Fake police identity cards were prepared to intimidate victims The gang specifically targeted older unmarried men from Haryana and Rajasthan through broker Raju Sharma. Rajasthan groom family trapped According to police, Mukesh Meena from Kota was searching for a bride for his brother Brajmohan Meena. Broker Raju Sharma allegedly showed them photographs of a “suitable girl” from Gorakhpur and convinced the family to travel for the wedding. On March 12, the family reached Gorakhpur carrying cash and jewellery. A garland exchange ceremony was organised at Ankur Singh’s house in Chiluatal. Soon after the ceremony, Ankur and his aides allegedly stormed in posing as police personnel and accused the family of conducting a fake marriage. Seven gang members already jailed Police earlier arrested seven accused in connection with the case: Police recovered around Rs 1.65 lakh, forged police identity cards and Aadhaar cards from the accused. Police expand hunt for associates SP North Gyanendra Kumar said the gang had carefully trained members to act like police officials during the extortion operation. The accused allegedly used fear, fake authority and staged weddings to trap victims from outside Uttar Pradesh. After Neelam Singh’s arrest, police are now searching for her alleged sworn sister and other associates linked to the network. Neelam was produced before a court on Tuesday evening and sent to judicial custody.

stories.title: Mulayam’s adopted son Prateek stayed away from politics:Bodybuilder-entrepreneur preferred private life despite family fame
stories.summary: Prateek Yadav loved luxury cars and bodybuilding. Though his father Mulayam Singh Yadav was among the country’s tallest political leaders, Prateek stayed away from the spotlight and political glamour. His childhood remained painful as he grew up separated from his biological father and lived only with his mother for years. In 2007, Mulayam Singh married his mother and later gave Prateek his place in the family. He studied in Britain and married BJP leader Aparna Yadav after a love relationship. The couple went through differences for some time before reconciling. Prateek was rarely seen in public and had gradually distanced himself even from close friends. Prateek was suffering from pulmonary embolism, a serious lung disease considered life-threatening. Only a few family members knew about his condition. Those close to him say his life always remained quiet, private and surrounded by mystery. Let's read the story of Prateek Yadav... First, 3 pictures of Prateek... Father left in childhood, then mother married Mulayam Prateek's father's name is Chandra Prakash Gupta and mother's name is Sadhana Gupta. Sadhana Gupta married Mulayam Singh Yadav in 2007. Prateek was born in 1987, while his biological parents Sadhana Gupta and Chandra Prakash Gupta got divorced in 1990. In 2007, Sadhana Gupta married Mulayam Singh Yadav, after which Mulayam adopted Prateek. Mulayam Singh Yadav had publicly acknowledged in an affidavit that Sadhana was his wife and Prateek was his son. Sadhana Gupta passed away 4 years ago. Prateek was fond of bodybuilding and cars Prateek Yadav was very conscious about fitness. He was not only a bodybuilder himself, but also motivated others for it. He had also opened a gym in Gomti Nagar. Along with bodybuilding, he also had a passion for luxury cars. He owned cars like Lamborghini and Porsche. After receiving his early education in Lucknow, he moved to Britain, from where he completed his MBA. Prateek remained more active in business, fitness, and social work rather than politics. He also ran an NGO called 'Jeev Aashray Foundation', which focused on social work such as animal welfare and helping homeless people. Met Aparna at a birthday party, had a love marriage The love story of Prateek and Aparna Yadav was quite talked about. Both were friends since school days. The two met at a friend's birthday party, where the friendship began with the exchange of email IDs. This friendship turned into an 8-10 year relationship without anyone realizing it. In 2011, both had a royal-style wedding in Saifai, which included big guests like Amitabh Bachchan. Prateek and Aparna have a daughter named Prathama. Aparna was initially associated with the Samajwadi Party. She contested elections from Lucknow Cantt in 2017, but lost. In 2022, Aparna joined the BJP and last year she was made the Vice President of the UP Women's Commission. Shocked everyone by announcing divorce, reconciled after 9 days Pratik Yadav had suddenly announced his divorce from his wife Aparna on January 19. He had said - Aparna made my life hell. However, after 9 days, the two reconciled. Sharing a picture with Aparna on Instagram, Pratik posted, "All is good. Champions are those who eliminate their personal and professional problems. We are a family of champions."

stories.title: Darkness covers Sambhal during daytime, heavy rain lashes Meerut:Severe heatwave from tomorrow, temperature may rise by 4-5°C; Banda hottest city in UP
stories.summary: The spell of storms and rain continues in Uttar Pradesh. At around 10 am on Wednesday, darkness covered the sky in Sambhal during the day as a dust storm swept through the area. This was followed by rain accompanied by strong winds. Meerut also witnessed heavy rainfall, while clouds continued to hover over Ghaziabad. A rain and thunderstorm alert has been issued for 38 districts today. Hailstorms are also likely in eastern UP. Earlier on Tuesday, Uttar Pradesh witnessed two different weather patterns. Rain accompanied by strong winds brought relief from the heat in 10 districts of western UP, while the Bundelkhand region continued to face intense heat. Banda remained the hottest city in the state over the past 24 hours, recording a temperature of 43.6°C. Dust storms with wind speeds of up to 50 kmph hit Bareilly and Rampur, uprooting unipoles installed along roadsides. In several places, tree branches fell on moving vehicles, causing traffic jams. Later, cranes were used to clear poles and fallen trees from the roads. Weather remained clear in eastern UP. The Meteorological Department has predicted thunderstorms and rain in 38 districts of western and eastern UP on Wednesday. Winds may blow at speeds of up to 60 kmph. Hailstorms and lightning strikes are also likely in some areas. Lucknow-based weather scientist Atul Kumar Singh said: “Weather conditions in UP will remain changed today and tomorrow. Rain accompanied by strong winds is expected. Wind speed may reach up to 50 kmph. A slight drop in temperature will be seen due to rain. From May 14, heat will intensify again. Temperatures may rise by 6 to 8 degrees and cross 45°C.” Weather visuals: Now know the condition of cities… Kanpur: The weather remained clear in the morning with bright sunshine. The temperature was around 32°C. Weather experts said the mercury may cross 38°C in the afternoon. Ghaziabad: Clouds have covered the sky since morning. Winds are blowing at speeds of 25 to 30 kmph. The minimum temperature recorded in the morning was 27°C. Bareilly: Bright sunshine has been seen since morning. Heavy rain and storms occurred yesterday. The current temperature is 27.4°C. The maximum temperature is expected to remain around 32°C and the minimum around 25.5°C. Gorakhpur: The effect of intense heat is visible. Strong sunshine since Wednesday morning has increased the heat and humidity. Due to weak winds, people are feeling more discomfort and humidity. How will the weather remain over the next 4 days? May 14: Weather will remain clear in eastern and western UP. Strong sunshine is expected. Nights may also remain warm at some places. May 15: Bright sunshine will continue across the state. The sky will remain clear. The temperature may reach 45°C. May 16: Heat will increase further due to clear skies and strong sunlight. Warm conditions will continue even at night. May 17: Dry weather will prevail across the state. No alert for storms or rain has been issued. Why is the weather fluctuating? According to the Meteorological Department, weather conditions are continuously changing in the hills of Uttarakhand. Some places are witnessing snowfall while others are receiving rain. On some days, the weather becomes clear with sunshine. Similar fluctuations are expected over the next few days. Its impact is being seen in UP. Winds coming from the hills are keeping the weather comparatively cool and are creating systems favourable for rain. Less rainfall expected during monsoon this year Private weather agency Skymet Weather has released its monsoon forecast for this year. According to it, rainfall during the monsoon may remain 6% below normal. The normal average rainfall in the country during the four monsoon months from June to September is 868.6 mm. Below-normal monsoon means rainfall may remain between 90% and 95% of the average. UP may also receive below-normal rainfall during monsoon The agency has predicted 94% rainfall this year. Rainfall may remain normal in June, but a decline may begin from July, with the monsoon weakening further in August and September. A larger rainfall deficit is expected, especially during August and September. There is a possibility of below-normal rainfall in Uttar Pradesh as well between June and September. IMD Director General Dr M Mahapatra said conditions similar to La Niña in the Pacific Ocean are ending and signs of El Niño are emerging, which may lead to reduced rainfall. This indicates that the southwest monsoon may remain weaker than normal this year. Less snow formation in the Northern Hemisphere between January and March may also affect the monsoon. Know about El Niño and La Niña El Niño: In this condition, sea surface temperatures rise by 3-4 degrees. Its effect is seen about twice in 10 years. Areas that usually receive heavy rainfall may get less rain, while low-rainfall regions may receive more rain. La Niña: In this condition, ocean water cools rapidly. It impacts weather patterns across the world. Clouds form in the sky, and good rainfall occurs.

stories.title: STF guns down Zubair in AMU teacher murder case:Munir gang operative killed in Meerut encounter; carried ₹1 lakh bounty, 24 cases lodged
stories.summary: The STF shot down Zubair, accused of murdering a teacher at Aligarh Muslim University, in Meerut on Wednesday at 4 AM. SP Brijesh Kumar Singh stated that they had received information that Zubair had come to Meerut to commit a murder. He was hiding in a closed factory and waiting for his associates. When the STF surrounded Zubair based on the information, he opened fire. In retaliatory firing, Zubair was shot in the stomach and chest. He died during treatment at the district hospital. According to the STF, 36 rounds were fired from both sides. In this, Zubair fired 20 rounds. The encounter took place in the Alipur police station area, 12 km from the city. Zubair was a member of the Munir gang. SP STF (In-charge, Meerut Unit) Brijesh Kumar Singh stated - Zubair, along with his associates, shot and killed teacher Danish Ali at AMU on December 24, 2025. In this case, the police had announced a reward of ₹1 lakh on him. Since then, the police had been searching for him. Today he was killed in an encounter. A bike, two 32-bore pistols and live cartridges have been recovered from Zubair. Entered the world of crime 11 years ago, joined Munir gang Zubair was a resident of Nausha village in the Barla police station area of Aligarh. At present, he was living in Shaheen Bagh, Delhi. He had stepped into the world of crime in 2015. In 2017, he joined the Munir gang. After that, he formed his own separate gang and started smuggling weapons. 24 cases were registered against him in Aligarh and Delhi under sections like murder and robbery. Fired 5 bullets at AMU teacher On the night of December 24, 2025, at 8:45 PM, AMU teacher Rao Danish Ali was walking out with his friends after strolling in Kennedy Hall Park. Near the Maulana Azad Library canteen, masked men stopped the scooter. He said, 'Now you will recognise who I am.' Saying this, the criminal fired bullets rapidly and fled. The bullet had hit Danish in the head. Friends informed his younger brother, Rao Faraz Ali. Faraz Ali, who was present at Suleman Hall near the incident site, reached the spot within moments and took his blood-soaked brother to the Medical College. There, doctors declared him dead. Rao Danish Ali was a computer teacher at AMU's ABK Boys School. At that time, police investigation revealed that Shahbez was murdered in 2018. Zubair, along with his brothers Yasir and Fahad, had carried out this crime. Zubair was sentenced to 7 years in this case. Zubair suspected that Danish had informed the police against him. After this, he had plotted Danish's murder. 4 criminals killed in encounters in 3 days In 3 days, four criminals have been killed in encounters. Before Zubair, on Monday night, Chandauli police killed psycho killer Gurpreet Singh, who had committed murder, in an encounter within 26 hours. Meanwhile, late Tuesday night in Ghaziabad, police gunned down two criminals, Sameer and Zubair, who had looted ₹27 lakh from a cash van, in an encounter. Finally, now learn about the Munir gang, with which Zubair was associated

stories.title: Psycho killer had planned to murder 7 more:Kills 3 within 25 hrs before encounter; entered railway stations carrying hidden weapons
stories.summary: Ex-Army personnel Gurpreet Singh, described by police as a “psycho killer,” had allegedly planned to murder 7 more people before he was killed in a police encounter after reportedly snatching a police officer’s pistol and trying to flee during a crime scene recreation. According to the police, Gurpreet had already shot dead three people within 25 hours using the same method, firing directly at the victims’ temples. Officers believe he intended to continue the killings in a similar pattern. Police recovered 10 cartridges from him, of which seven were still unused. Was suffering from depression Gurpreet, a resident of Punjab, had arrived in Uttar Pradesh 13 days before the encounter. Villagers said he was suffering from depression, rarely spoke to anyone, and did not have disputes with locals. They added that he consumed alcohol heavily. After his death, UP Police informed his family in Tarhatuchak village in Punjab. Following the information, Gurpreet Singh’s brother-in-law, another relative, and the village sarpanch reached Chandauli to claim the body. Read the full report… Had 2 houses in the village, lived separately from elderly parents The 45-year-old psycho killer who spread terror by committing 3 murders was a resident of the Tarn Taran district in Punjab. Gurpreet's ancestral home is in Tarhatuchak village, where his joint family lives. This includes elderly parents, 2 brothers, and their families. He had come to the village after retiring from the army. Here, his father gave Gurpreet a piece of land about 20 steps away from the house. He built his own house on this. Then he started living with his wife Ramanjit Kaur, 13-year-old son Gursevak Singh, and 14-year-old daughter Ashwin Kaur. Punjab police passes information about his death After the encounter of Gurpreet in the Chandauli district of UP, the police contacted Punjab. The police informed some family members about Gurpreet's death. His wife, Ramanjeet, has not been informed about the death yet. Villagers said that Gurpreet Singh was here till April 29. After that, he went to UP. He had told everyone that he got a job in a bank. After that, information about his death was received. Just a year ago, on May 3, 2025, Gurpreet's mother, Narinder Kaur, had passed away. Gurpreet had 10 bighas of land, and he used to farming The villagers said that after retiring from the army, Gurpreet was in depression. His medication was ongoing. He was of a quiet nature. He talked less with people. Whoever he met, he spoke with them lovingly. However, he was addicted to drinking alcohol. He had also had a fight while intoxicated, in which bullets were fired. However, family members denied any such fight. Gurpreet's brother is a truck driver. He said that after retiring from the army, he used to go to different states for bank security jobs. He didn't tell us much. Gurpreet had about 10 bighas of land. He used to give it on contract for farming. When he was in the army, he had a turban on his head and a beard Villagers showed an old photo of Gurpreet, which was from his time in the army. Gurpreet was in Sikh form. He had a turban on his head and a beard. People said that after falling into depression, he had cut his hair. He had also removed his beard. Family members had tried to explain to him, but he did not agree. He either stayed at his home or left the village for work. Metal detectors couldn't catch, weapon was in bag Meanwhile, UP Police investigation revealed that Gurpreet Singh left from Ara in Bihar for Prayagraj on May 9. The same day, he reached Mugalsarai, 153 km away from there. He had a revolver and a double-barreled gun with him. He had cut the barrel of the gun. That's why he brought it in a bag. Metal detectors were installed at the station. But neither the RPF staff nor the detectors could catch that he had 2 weapons in his bag. He stayed at the station all night. After this, he committed 2 murders on 2 trains. Then he killed a woman admitted to a hospital. 3 things were common in these murders- 1. Gurpreet did not know anyone beforehand. 2. All were shot in the temple. 3. After one murder, he started searching for the next target. Lost job after a fight at a bank in Kolkata, then reached Ara In 2006, Gurpreet got a job in the Army. After completing 15 years of service in 2021, he was retired. While working, Gurpreet had obtained a license for a double-barreled gun. After his army job, he joined a security agency. This agency provided guards to banks in different states. Gurpreet was mostly posted at a bank in Kolkata. There, Gurpreet's excessive drinking habit led to complaints reaching the agency. Then he was removed. Therefore, Gurpreet had applied for a guard job at a bank in the Ara district of Bihar. He reached Bihar on April 29 for the job. Here he joined the job. He went to the bank for only 4-5 days. Here, too, he started having quarrels with employees and customers. Fed up, the bank manager told him that you don't need to come to work anymore. After losing his job, Gurpreet should have returned to Punjab. But he started roaming around Chandauli and Mugalsarai station. DIG says- Gurpreet himself did not know where he would go A question arose in this entire matter: why was Gurpreet going from Ara to Prayagraj? Regarding this, Varanasi Range DIG Vaibhav Krishna said that after reaching Ara station on May 9, Gurpreet was not clear about where to go. That's why he boarded a train going to Prayagraj. After coming near Varanasi, he got down again. From here, he caught a train back and got off at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Junction. He had a bag with him, which contained about ₹10 thousand and some clothes. There was a revolver and a double-barreled gun, whose barrel he had cut from the front. DIG said that during interrogation, he did not clearly explain the reason for committing 3 murders. He just shot whoever came in front of him. Gurpreet's family has been informed. More will be known about this after talking to them. Police are also gathering information about his previous crimes. Went to station with weapon, officers avoiding speaking A person roamed around the station with a weapon, but the guards deployed for security could not catch him. This is a major security lapse. The question arises - whose responsibility is this? Can anyone travel with a weapon like this at the junction and then on the train? We tried to talk to the railway officials, but they kept avoiding saying anything about it.

stories.title: Chandrashekhar claims to form government like Vijay:Will visit Tamil Nadu to study victory formula; workers to seek door-to-door support in UP
stories.summary: New faces got an opportunity in Tamil Nadu. If a party formed just two years ago can come to power, then why can’t the Azad Samaj Party achieve the same in UP? We just need to put in the effort. We will form the government in UP. - Chandrashekhar, 6 May, Saharanpur This enthusiasm is not limited to just statements. Chandrashekhar is going to start a 'Power Change Yatra' from June 2. His workers will seek support from the public in all 403 assembly constituencies of UP. Film star Thalapathy Vijay surprised everyone by winning 118 out of 234 seats in his very first election. He is now the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. A senior leader of the Azad Samaj Party informed that Chandrashekhar will go to Tamil Nadu this month. There, he will understand the formula of political victory with Chief Minister Vijay. Read the full report Know about both leaders... Vijay is a South superstar, Chandrashekhar is a hero of Dalits Vijay is a superstar of South films. For his entry into politics, he made his films the base. In films, he targeted GST, the poor condition of farmers, and corporate corruption. Due to this, the people of Tamil Nadu started calling him 'Thalapathy' (Commander). Vijay opened libraries, ambulances, and food distribution centers in every block through his fan club Vijay Makkal Iyakkam (VMI). This increased public trust. After this, he launched his party, 'Tamizhaga Vetri Kazhagam' (TVK) on February 2, 2024. This is how he entered politics. Chandrashekhar entered politics through student politics. In 2015, during his law studies, he formed an organization called 'Bhim Army'. In 2017, he went to jail in the Saharanpur violence. Sections of the National Security Act (NSA) were imposed. After coming out of jail, he transformed from a student leader to a 'hero of Dalits'. Because the message went out that Chandrashekhar speaks for Dalits, raising their voice. On March 15, 2020, on Kanshi Ram's birth anniversary, he launched the Azad Samaj Party (Kanshiram) (ASP). Now understand the politics of UP-Tamil Nadu... Film stars have an important role in Tamil Nadu, caste-religion is a big factor in UP Tamil Nadu's electoral narrative starts with caste and ends with state rights. Film stars also play an important role here. People worship them like gods. MG Ramachandran was the first such superstar who remained Chief Minister for 10 years. J. Jayalalithaa was also a big cinema star. Later, she became the most powerful woman in politics as 'Amma'. M. Karunanidhi was a scriptwriter. The dialogues of his films laid the foundation of Dravidian politics. Vijay is the new heir to this 'star-to-leader' legacy. Senior journalist Ratanmani Lal says, 'UP's politics is completely different. Here, caste and religion are very big factors. For Chandrashekhar, forming a government in UP is not that easy. In Tamil Nadu, Vijay's fan clubs built his image at the block level'. Vijay talks about taking every caste and religion along. So far, he has not made any controversial statement. Being a soft image film actor, he has come close to the public. How Chandrashekhar will understand how to reach all sections in Tamil Nadu To understand Chandrashekhar's preparations, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to a senior leader of the Azad Samaj Party. He says in UP, there is a challenge to reach all sections. But Vijay also faced a similar challenge in Tamil Nadu. What strategy did he adopt to reach all sections? To understand this, Chandrashekhar will go to Tamil Nadu this month. He will meet Chief Minister Vijay there. He will understand his Tamil Nadu victory formula, which can prove helpful in UP. Chandrashekhar strengthened by Jatav community votes In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, BSP's vote share fell by 9.9% compared to 2019. In 2019, BSP received 19.4% votes. However, in 2024, it received only 9.5% votes. It was believed that a portion of this shifted towards Chandrashekhar's party. According to data, Dalits, especially Jatav youth, voted for Chandrashekhar's party instead of SP-BSP. Talking about the Muslim vote bank, until 2022, it used to be divided among SP, BSP, and Congress. However, in the 2024 elections, more than 90% of Muslim votes went to the INDIA alliance (SP+Congress). BSP received only 2% Muslim votes, which used to be 18% in 2014. This is directly benefiting SP and Congress. Before 2027, Akhilesh will have to improve relations with Rahul The Azad Samaj Party talks about contesting elections alone. However, it does not have a voter base anywhere strong enough to defeat the BJP. To take on the BJP in 2027, Chandrashekhar will have to improve relations with both Akhilesh and Rahul. This is because SP-Congress has a good vote bank among the OBC and Muslim communities. According to CSDS-Lokniti, a polling study organization, approximately 52% of UP's population is OBC. Of these, 9-10% are Yadavs. SP has the strongest share of this vote bank. In the 2024 elections, approximately 80-85% of Yadav votes went to the SP-Congress alliance. Kurmi, Maurya, Nishad, and Pal constitute approximately 35-40%. Until 2022, BJP had a strong hold among these groups. In 2024, SP made significant inroads here. According to the survey, SP received approximately 25-30% of non-Yadav OBC votes.
