stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. NEET-UG exam cancelled after paper leak , CBI takes over investigation National Testing Agency cancelled NEET-UG 2026 over alleged paper leaks. NTA Director General accepted responsibility and said fresh exam dates would be announced within 6–8 days. The government has handed the case to CBI for a detailed probe. 2. Ex-army man turned 'psychopath killer' gunned down in encounter A man accused of killing three people within 26 hours in Uttar Pradesh’s Chandauli district was killed in a police encounter late Monday night after he allegedly opened fire during a crime scene reconstruction exercise. 3. Brij Bhushan influence remains intact as Gonda chosen for tournament venue again The Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) commenced the Senior Open Ranking Tournament 2026 at Nandininagar, Gonda on May 10. Since 2018, the tournament has been held only three times, and all three editions have taken place in Gonda. 4. Tamil Nadu CM Vijay meets AIADMK MLA CV Shanmugam Vijay, Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu and chief of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam, on Tuesday visited the office of CV Shanmugam and met a group of rebel All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam MLAs ahead of the crucial floor test in the Assembly. 5. Yogi, Rajnath Singh visit Kamakhya Temple after attending Assam CM swearing-in ceremony Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Adityanath turned the Assam swearing-in ceremony into a wider political show of NDA unity on Tuesday, joining Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and several BJP leaders at the grand event in Guwahati. 6. Akhilesh Yadav takes swipe at BJP over Pooja Pal Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav visited Prayagraj on Tuesday, where he launched sharp attacks on the BJP government and Prime Minister Narendra Modi. 7. Sensex plunges 1,456 points, Nifty down 436 The BSE Sensex closed at 1,456 points lower to 74,559, while Nifty 50 settled 436 points lower to 23,379. 8. UP records 25 suicides daily; love affair-linked deaths jump fourfold in five years Around 25 people are committing suicide every day in UP. Where 4,804 total suicide cases were registered in 2020, this number increased to 9,180 in 2024. 9. Ghaziabad woman alleges 13 years of abuse, ’Halala' and assault ‘In 13 years, my life was destroyed. I was raped. Whenever I protested, I was beaten naked. I was beaten for not reading the namaz. I had 5 nikahs and had to endure halala twice.’ This is the statement of a 31-year-old Hindu woman living in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Her allegation is that a Muslim youth befriended her on Facebook, posing as a Hindu. After that, he called me to Uttar Pradesh to meet. Here I was held captive. 10. Pak allowed Iran to park military aircraft while mediating talks, claims report Pakistan allegedly sheltered an Iranian military aircraft at its Nur Khan Airbase during the US-Iran war. Report claimed that days after an April ceasefire, Iran sent several aircraft to the base, including an RC-130, an intelligence and surveillance variant of the US-made Lockheed C-130 Hercules transport aircraft.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav takes swipe at BJP over Pooja Pal:Samajwadi Chief says, ‘make her Deputy CM if you care so much’
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav visited Prayagraj on Tuesday, where he launched sharp attacks on the BJP government and Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Referring to MLA Pooja Pal, Akhilesh said, “If the Chief Minister and BJP have so much affection for Pooja Pal, they should make her Deputy Chief Minister. Even if there are three Deputy Chief Ministers, what problem would that create?” His remarks came amid speculation that Pooja Pal could be inducted into the Uttar Pradesh cabinet, though her name was eventually dropped. Pays tribute at Rita Bahuguna Joshi’s residence Before addressing the media, Akhilesh visited the residence of BJP leader and former MP Rita Bahuguna Joshi in Civil Lines, Prayagraj, to pay tribute to her late husband, Puran Chand Joshi. He remained with the family for nearly half an hour during the condolence meeting. Akhilesh criticises PM Modi’s appeal on gold and fuel During the interaction with reporters, Akhilesh criticised PM Modi’s recent appeal urging citizens to save petrol and diesel and avoid buying gold for one year. He said, “Who is responsible for the economy slowing down? Who is in power? Why is the rupee weakening? Why are such appeals being made? This is an appeal born out of decline. Those who lost the Lok Sabha elections will continue to lose despite these appeals. BJP itself is the crisis.” Reacts to Samajwadi Party MP’s offensive remark against PM Akhilesh also reacted to controversial remarks made by Samajwadi Party MP Ajendra Lodhi against PM Modi. “We have never supported such language or behaviour. Such comments should not be made against the Prime Minister,” he said. However, he also questioned statements made by BJP leaders in Parliament and referred to previous controversial remarks by political leaders. Accuses BJP leaders in criminal cases Akhilesh alleged that a person arrested in the murder case of Chandranath Rath, personal assistant to West Bengal leader Suvendu Adhikari, had links with BJP leaders. He claimed photographs of the accused with BJP leaders had surfaced and also referred to an alleged ₹100 crore scam involving a BJP leader in Jhansi. Tight security during visit Akhilesh arrived at Prayagraj airport around 1 pm from Lucknow on a private aircraft and travelled directly to Rita Bahuguna Joshi’s residence. Heavy police deployment was arranged in the area, with barricades installed to control crowds and supporters. He later visited the residence of SP leader Vasudev Yadav before returning to Lucknow.

stories.title: Heated exchange between SP MP and UP Minister in Mau:Rajiv Rai points finger at AK Sharma, says ‘you’ve become arrogant’
stories.summary: A heated confrontation broke out between Uttar Pradesh Energy Minister AK Sharma and Samajwadi Party MP Rajiv Rai during the inauguration ceremony of the MEMU train in Mau on Monday. During the argument on stage, the SP MP pointed a finger at the minister and said, “Minister ji, this is not right. I am the MP from here. The police are pushing my workers right in front of me. You have become arrogant after becoming a minister. This arrogance is not good.” Leaders and officials present on the stage intervened and calmed both leaders. Meanwhile, SP and BJP workers also clashed, leading to heavy pushing and shoving. The police and Railway Protection Force (RPF) somehow managed to control the situation. At 4 pm, Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the MEMU train through video conferencing. See 4 pictures- Sloganeering led to chaos at railway station The inauguration programme for the MEMU train on the Dohrighat-Aunrihar route was held at Dohrighat Railway Station in Mau district on Monday afternoon. Minister AK Sharma, district representatives and BJP leaders were already present when SP MP Rajiv Rai arrived around 2:30 pm with his supporters. SP workers began raising slogans, after which BJP workers also started sloganeering. The dispute escalated quickly into pushing and shoving between workers of both parties. SP leaders allegedly pushed off stage During the commotion, Sujeet Singh, son of late MLA Sudhakar Singh from Ghosi, and SP leader Akhilesh Rathore allegedly tried to climb onto the stage. The Circle Officer (CO) of Madhuban reportedly pushed Akhilesh Rathore off the stage. Sujeet Singh was also removed from the platform. It was alleged that BJP workers stopped MP Rajiv Rai from going towards the stage, after which he became angry. The police and RPF eventually controlled the situation. Both AK Sharma and Rajiv Rai appealed to supporters to remain calm. The disturbance reportedly continued for nearly two hours. Rajiv Rai accuses BJP workers of creating disturbance Rajiv Rai later said Ghosi’s political history had always reflected mutual respect and harmony, but alleged that “goons nurtured by a BJP leader” had tarnished it for the sake of contracts. He said the people of Ghosi would never forgive those responsible and questioned how BJP workers could stop an elected MP from attending a public programme. The MP claimed there was no issue from his side on the stage and alleged that some people were deliberately trying to create chaos. He also alleged that “contractor-type people” were trying to dominate the programme and said his vehicle was not even allowed to move ahead despite him being elected by five lakh votes. Firing reported during BJP workers’ clash Amid the event, a separate clash reportedly broke out between two BJP factions. The dispute escalated to the extent that one group allegedly opened fire at the venue, creating panic among those present. A video of the incident has also surfaced.

stories.title: Yogi, Rajnath Singh visit Kamakhya Temple:Jai Shri Ram slogans raised at Guwahati Airport; Anupriya Rajbhar also attend oath ceremony
stories.summary: Chief Minister Adityanath turned the Assam swearing-in ceremony into a wider political show of NDA unity on Tuesday, joining Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and several BJP leaders at the grand event in Guwahati. After attending the oath ceremony of Himanta Biswa Sarma, Yogi travelled to the revered Kamakhya Temple with Rajnath Singh and offered prayers. Earlier in the morning, the Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister received a loud welcome at Guwahati airport as BJP supporters raised slogans of “Jai Shri Ram”. Yogi responded with folded hands before heading to the venue. NDA leaders share stage The ceremony at Khanapara Veterinary College Ground reflected the BJP’s effort to project organisational strength across eastern and northeastern India. Both Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Ministers — Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak — attended the programme and were seated behind Yogi on the main stage. Also present were: Himanta Biswa Sarma took oath as Assam Chief Minister for a second consecutive term, while four other MLAs were sworn in as ministers. BJP highlights eastern expansion Speaking on the occasion, Brajesh Pathak said Assam was moving ahead in step with the country and claimed the BJP’s rise in West Bengal reflected growing support for “Sanatan culture”. Keshav Maurya described the BJP’s third consecutive term in Assam as a reward for development and governance. Anupriya Patel said the NDA government had earned public trust by ensuring peace and accelerating development in the state. Key political takeaways: Yogi’s campaign strike rate BJP leaders also highlighted Yogi’s campaign success in the Northeast. The UP Chief Minister campaigned in two Assam seats, with BJP and ally Asom Gana Parishad winning both. Party leaders called it another example of Yogi’s strong electoral strike rate outside Uttar Pradesh. The BJP also pointed to his campaign in West Bengal, where the party reportedly won 31 of the 35 Assembly seats where he addressed rallies. Earlier this week, Yogi had attended the swearing-in ceremony of Suvendu Adhikari in Kolkata, where actor-turned-politician Mithun Chakraborty touched his feet on stage and sought blessings amid loud cheers from party workers.

stories.title: Vinesh Phogat vs WFI:Wrestler questions choice of Gonda as tournament venue, where Brij Bhushan wields influence despite no official role
stories.summary: The Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) commenced the Senior Open Ranking Tournament 2026 at Nandininagar, Gonda on May 10. Since 2018, the tournament has been held only three times, and all three editions have taken place in Gonda. This has raised a key question: why does the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) consistently choose Gonda as the venue instead of cities like Delhi or Lucknow, which have better infrastructure? WFI headquarters is located in Delhi, which houses the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, while Lucknow also has facilities such as the K.D. Singh Babu Stadium. Yet, Gonda continues to host the event. Read the report… Vinesh Phogat raises concerns over fairness Congress leader and wrestler Vinesh Phogat has questioned the choice of venue. In a video released ahead of the 2026 National Ranking Wrestling Tournament, she alleged that the location raises concerns over fairness and transparency. She said, “The tournament is being organised at a place where Brij Bhushan Singh’s residence is located. Everything—from which referee officiates which match to scoring decisions and outcomes—is controlled by Brij Bhushan and his people.” Her remarks have reignited debate over whether influence persists even after Brij Bhushan Singh stepped down as WFI president. Haryana athletes question venue decision Nearly 800 wrestlers are participating in the tournament, of which around 80% are from Haryana. The state has several international-level stadiums in cities like Rohtak, Sonipat, Hisar, and Jind. This has led to questions over why the event is not being held in Haryana or Delhi, where sports infrastructure is significantly stronger. WFI defends decision, cites infrastructure WFI president Sanjay Singh dismissed the allegations, saying Vinesh Phogat tends to make such claims frequently. He added that when she expressed interest in participating, the federation ensured full security arrangements. However, she has been banned due to doping-related issues. According to WFI, the venue was selected after inspecting multiple stadiums. Officials said Nandini Nagar Sports College in Gonda was chosen because it can accommodate around 1,000 wrestlers along with adequate lodging facilities. Other venues, they said, could not manage such large-scale arrangements on short notice. Mixed Reactions From Wrestlers Participants gave mixed feedback about the arrangements. A wrestler from Punjab said, “Food and accommodation arrangements here are good, and the atmosphere is positive.” A Haryana wrestler who finished third in the 125 kg freestyle category said there is no political interference affecting players. However, another wrestler from Haryana said facilities would have been better in Delhi, citing easier travel and accommodation. Tournament linked to Nandini Nagar legacy The National Ranking Tournament was launched in 2022 when Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh was WFI president. His son, Karan Bhushan Singh, currently heads the Uttar Pradesh Wrestling Association. This has contributed to several wrestling events being held at Nandini Nagar Sports College in Gonda. Brij Bhushan Singh has previously said he is simply a supporter of wrestling and prefers events to be held in Nandini Nagar due to his interest in the sport, and has discussed organising ranking tournaments with WFI officials.

stories.title: Husband-wife duo commit suicide in Gorakhpur:Man's body found hanging from noose, woman's dead body was on the bed; both married 5 months ago
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, a newlywed couple died five months after their wedding. On Tuesday morning, both their bodies were found in their room. The wife was pregnant. The incident came to light when the room's door did not open in the morning. When family members broke open the door and went inside, they were shocked to see both the bodies. Family members reported that foam was coming out of the deceased woman's mouth. This has raised suspicion of suicide by consuming a poisonous substance. Police launch probe Meanwhile, local police are present at the scene following information from family members. Police have taken possession of both bodies and started an investigation. Police say that the exact cause of death can only be determined after the postmortem report arrives. For now, the case is being linked to domestic dispute and mutual conflict. There is an atmosphere of mourning in the house after the death of the newlywed couple. Family members are in a terrible state, crying inconsolably. First 2 Pictures Marriage took place five months ago The deceased have been identified as Shadab (25) son of Tasveer Ali and his wife Nikhat (23), residents of Mukarrimpur village. Both were married five months ago. This morning both their bodies were found in the room. The case came to light when their room door did not open for a long time. When family members became worried, they called out loudly. When there was no response, the family members somehow opened the door. After which they were shocked to see the scene inside. Husband found hanging from noose, wife lying on bed Family members reported that husband Shadab's body was hanging from a noose supported by the fan. Meanwhile, wife Nikhat was lying dead on the bed. There was a bedsheet on the body. It is being reported that Nikhat was pregnant. According to eyewitnesses, white foam was coming out of her mouth. Seeing this, it is being suspected that the woman must have consumed some poisonous substance. However, it is not yet clear what had happened between the husband and wife. As soon as information about the incident was received, there was panic in the village. Belghaat police, who arrived on information, have taken both bodies into custody and started investigation. Police are investigating the case keeping in mind family and other aspects.

stories.title: BHU students trigger chaos at hospital OPD:Nearly 200 patients return without treatment after heated argument stalls Gastro dept consultations
stories.summary: Chaos erupted at the Gastroenterology OPD of Banaras Hindu University’s Sir Sunderlal Hospital on Monday afternoon after a group of students allegedly tried to bypass the token system and enter the doctor’s chamber directly. The disruption brought outpatient services to a halt for several hours, leaving nearly 200 patients without medical consultation. The incident unfolded around 2:30 PM when a few students reached the department with a patient and attempted to meet department head Dr. Devesh Yadav without taking a token number. Argument snowballs inside OPD Security personnel posted outside the chamber stopped the students and asked them to follow the queue system already in place due to heavy patient rush. Witnesses said the students argued that they were from BHU and should be allowed priority access. Soon, resident doctors rushed to the spot after hearing loud arguments inside the crowded OPD. The confrontation quickly escalated, drawing attention from patients and attendants waiting nearby. Doctors halt consultations midway As tempers rose, Dr. Devesh Yadav himself stepped out to calm the situation. Despite repeated appeals from doctors and staff, the dispute continued, forcing medical consultations to stop midway. At that point: Several patients expressed frustration after waiting for hours without receiving treatment. Security cover to be strengthened Following the incident, hospital authorities indicated that security arrangements inside the Gastro department would be tightened to avoid similar disruptions in future. Deputy Chief Proctor Dr. Ashutosh Pathak said the unusually high patient turnout in the department contributed to the situation spiralling out of control. He added that additional security guards would now be deployed in the Gastro OPD, while bouncers could also be stationed wherever required to manage crowds and maintain order.

stories.title: FIR lodged against SP MP in Mahoba:Ajendra Singh had dubbed PM Modi as ‘anti-national’; BJP workers and leaders protest across district
stories.summary: An FIR was registered on Tuesday against Samajwadi Party MP Ajendra Singh Lodhi in Uttar Pradesh’s Mahoba over alleged objectionable remarks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The case was lodged at City Kotwali police station following a complaint by BJP district media in-charge Satyendra Pratap Gupta. Police said the FIR names the MP along with several unidentified supporters under serious sections linked to provocative and objectionable public statements. Statement made during protest march The controversy erupted a day after the SP MP reached the Collectorate with party workers to submit a memorandum of 11 demands, including opposition to smart electricity meters and rising inflation. SP district president Shobha Lal Yadav was also present during the protest. While speaking to journalists, Lodhi launched a sharp attack on the Prime Minister and allegedly used indecent language on camera. Key points from the controversy: BJP workers protest at Kotwali The remarks triggered immediate political backlash in Mahoba. Angry BJP workers staged protests outside the Kotwali police station, raised slogans and burnt an effigy of the SP MP. Party leaders termed the comments “insulting” and demanded strict legal action. BJP’s district media in-charge later submitted a formal complaint, after which police registered the FIR. The SP MP also warned that if civic issues, including drain cleaning and repair of a damaged culvert in Charkhari, were not resolved before June 15, the government would “face consequences”. First-time MP with political legacy Ajendra Singh Lodhi is a first-time MP from Mahoba and the son of former MLA Chandranarayan Singh Lodhi alias Bade Lallu, who represented the constituency twice in 1969 and 1974. During the interaction, the MP also claimed that “PDA Backward, Dalit and Minority communities, will teach the BJP a lesson in 2027” and asserted that the Samajwadi Party would return to power with full majority support.

stories.title: Weather shifts in Uttar Pradesh today again:Rain lashes eight western districts dust storms hit Meerut Bijnor alert for 38 cities Banda hottest
stories.summary: The weather in Uttar Pradesh changed sharply on Tuesday morning. Several districts in western UP—including Bareilly, Meerut, Moradabad, Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, Amroha, Sambhal, and Bijnor—witnessed heavy rainfall accompanied by thunder and lightning. Before the rain, the sky suddenly turned cloudy, and strong dust-laden winds swept through parts of the region. In several areas, daylight turned unusually dark due to dense cloud cover. Meanwhile, eastern Uttar Pradesh remained largely clear. IMD issues alert for 38 districts The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an alert for 38 districts today, warning of thunderstorms accompanied by rain. Officials have also cautioned that some areas may experience hailstorms and lightning strikes. Wind speeds are expected to remain high, and weather conditions may stay unstable throughout the day. Heat persists despite weather shift On Monday, maximum temperatures in the state approached 42°C. Banda recorded the highest temperature at 41.6°C, making it the hottest city in Uttar Pradesh. Almost all districts recorded minimum temperatures above 20°C, meaning nights also remained uncomfortably warm with no relief from the heat. Weather expert forecast Atul Kumar Singh, a meteorologist from Lucknow, said, The weather in UP will remain changeable today and tomorrow. Strong winds along with rain are expected, with wind speeds reaching up to 50 kmph. Temperatures will see a slight drop due to rainfall. However, from May 14, heat will intensify again, with temperatures rising by 6–8°C and crossing 45°C. Five-day weather forecast for UP

stories.title: Ex-army man turned 'psychopath killer' gunned down in encounter:Killed 3 people in 26 hours in UP’s Chandauli
stories.summary: A man accused of killing three people within 26 hours in Uttar Pradesh’s Chandauli district was killed in a police encounter late Monday night after he allegedly opened fire during a crime scene reconstruction exercise. The accused, Gurpreet Singh (45), a retired army personnel, was taken by police teams to recreate the crime scenes when he allegedly snatched a pistol from an officer and attempted to escape after opening fire. In retaliatory firing, he sustained bullet injuries to the head and chest. He was taken to a district hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Two police personnel were also injured in the incident. See 3 pictures related to the encounter- Three killings in 26 hours: identical execution pattern Police said Gurpreet Singh carried out three murders in rapid succession, all involving victims being shot at close range in the head. 1. First murder – Passenger train (Sunday morning, ~7 AM) He allegedly shot a young man, Mangru, inside a passenger train in Chandauli. After the train slowed near a station, he reportedly threw the body onto the tracks and escaped. 2. Second murder – Jammu Tawi Express (Sunday night, ~2 AM) While travelling on the Jammu Tawi Express, he allegedly shot Dinesh Sahu in the head as the victim exited a train toilet. He escaped when the train slowed down. 3. Third murder – Private hospital (Monday morning, ~8:30 AM) He allegedly entered Jeevak Hospital and shot a bedridden woman, Lakshmina Devi (55), at close range in the temple. After the attack, he tried to flee but was caught by civilians and handed over to police after being beaten. An eyewitness said, He was firing while running. I was unloading a patient outside the hospital when I heard people shouting. We caught him after a struggle. He pointed a gun at me, but I twisted his hand and the weapon fell to the ground. “I am the king of my mind”: confession after arrest Following his arrest after the hospital shooting, Gurpreet Singh reportedly gave a chilling statement to police. He said: “I am the king of my mind. After drinking alcohol, I lose consciousness. I do whatever comes to my mind. I have killed two to three people.” Police officials said he later confessed to all three murders during interrogation. How police identified the suspect Investigators linked the killings due to a consistent pattern—victims were shot at close range in the head. A police official said witness inputs helped confirm his identity: “He had a saffron scarf tied on his head, was wearing a pant-shirt, and was around 6 feet tall.” Police said the similarity in execution style helped establish that the same person was behind all three killings. Background of the accused Police said Gurpreet Singh was originally from Amritsar, Punjab. A police officer said, Gurpreet used to lose mental balance after drinking alcohol. He would get into fights and behave violently. He appears to be a psychopathic type in preliminary investigation. Encounter after crime scene reconstruction On Monday night, police, Government Railway Police, and SWAT teams took him near railway tracks in Darayapur village for reconstruction of the crime scenes. According to SP Akash Patel, At around 12 midnight, the police, GRP, and SWAT team took the accused to the railway line near Darayapur village for crime scene reconstruction. During this, he snatched the pistol of a police officer and fired shots. Two police personnel were injured in the incident. After this, joint police teams retaliated and in the firing, he sustained one bullet in the chest and one in the head. He was taken to hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Investigation continues Police said further investigation is underway into his movements, weapon access, and the timeline of all three murders across trains and the hospital.

stories.title: 'He posed as Naveen, trapped me for years’:Ghaziabad woman alleges 13 years of abuse, 'halala' and assault
stories.summary: 'In 13 years, my life was destroyed. I was raped. Whenever I protested, I was beaten naked. I was beaten for not reading the namaz. I had 5 nikahs and had to endure halala twice.' This is the statement of a 31-year-old Hindu woman living in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Her allegation is that a Muslim youth befriended her on Facebook, posing as a Hindu. After that, he called me to Uttar Pradesh to meet. Here I was held captive. Then, I was forcibly converted. After that, I was married off to a Maulana who was 25 years older than me. Then the Maulana gave me triple talaq. After that, my halala was performed, and I was married off at another place. In this way, I had 5 nikahs, and halala was performed twice. The woman had filed a case on May 5 at Ankur Vihar police station against 16 people, including 13 named accused. Police arrested one accused on May 7. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to the woman and understood her pain. Read the woman's complete story, in her own words I was 18 years old and studying BBA. During this time in the year 2012, I became friends on Facebook with a boy living in Muzaffarnagar. He told me his name was Naveen Rana. We both started talking. One day, Naveen Rana came to Indore to meet me. He gave me a mobile and a SIM. After staying there for a few days, Naveen returned to Muzaffarnagar. In 2013, Naveen called me to Delhi. At his request, I reached Delhi from Indore. I met Naveen in Delhi. From there, he took me to a madrasa located in Falat, Muzaffarnagar. After staying here for 2 days, Naveen said that my mother had an accident, and I am going to Dehradun. Naveen left me at the madrasa and went to Dehradun. Here I came to know that Naveen's real name is Naved. I was married to a Maulana, 25 years older than me, in the madrasa After Naveen left, I was held captive there. Maulana Kaleem of Falat forcibly converted my religion. I was made to wear a burqa. I protested and said that I am not Muslim. After this, I was beaten. I was told that you have now become Muslim and will stay here. After keeping me there for 6-7 days, I was brought to a madrasa near the bus stand in Meerut. Other women lived there. I remained captive in that same madrasa in Meerut for 6 months. After this, I was again taken to Falat in Muzaffarnagar. Here I was forcibly married to Abdur Rahman, who is 25 years older than me. Abdur Rahman used to rape me every day. When I would resist, he would strip me naked and beat me. He would drag me by my hair. He would ask me to read namaz. When I refused, he would beat me. After 2 months, Abdur Rahman took me back to Maulana Kaleem in Phalat. He said that she doesn't know how to talk to her husband properly. After this, Abdur Rahman gave me triple talaq. 3 months of iddat after divorce After the divorce from Abdur Rahman, I was kept with Maulana Kaleem again. After this, I had to stay in Iddat for 3 months in a madrasa in Meerut. From there, I was taken to a madrasa in Jaipur. Here, I was raped for five days in the name of halala. When I protested, I was held hostage and beaten with kicks and slaps. After keeping me there for a few days, I was brought to the Shamli district. Here in 2015, my second nikah was performed with Mudsir. After the nikah, he took me to Gujarat. There he worked as a welder. In 2019, Mudsir died. I had now become homeless. I had no contact with my family members. There, I met a maulana named Aslam. Nikah was performed with Khalid Hussain in Baghpat Maulana Qari Aslam took me from Gujarat to a religious place in Shaheen Bagh, Delhi. Then he took me from Delhi to Saharanpur and from Saharanpur to Baghpat. There, my third nikah was performed with Khalid Hussain. Khalid told me that my first wife had died. Khalid Hussain lived on rent in Loni, Ghaziabad. So he took me to Ghaziabad. After staying here for a few days, Khalid and his family members started harassing me. In 2022, Khalid divorced me. After this, Khalid's mother said that he had given a divorce in anger. Now, where will you stay? Then Khalid said that I will marry you only when your halala is done. After this, Khalid took me to Baghpat. There, Khalid got my fourth nikah performed with his brother-in-law, Fakruddin. After this, Khalid and his brother, Sakib, gang-raped me. Then he divorced me and said now you can marry Khalid. After this, Maulana Furqan performed my fifth nikah with Khalid. Khalid started torturing me. I somehow escaped from Khalid's clutches and reached BJP MLA Nand Kishore. He helped me get justice. After this, I went to the police station on May 5 and filed a report narrating the entire story. Currently, I am living alone in a rented house near the Delhi border in Ghaziabad. Case registered against these people The woman has registered a case at Ankur Vihar police station in Ghaziabad against 16 people, including Naveen Rana alias Naved (Ghaziabad), Maulana Kaleem Siddiqui, his wife and daughter-in-law, Abdul Rahman, Maulana Bilal, Qari Aslam, Hafiz Nawab, Maulana Rashid, Fakhruddin, Maulana Furqan Qureshi, Khalid Hussain, and Shakib. She has leveled allegations against them, including forced religious conversion, multiple nikahs, halala, rape, physical and mental torture, and death threats. Police have arrested the accused Khalid Hussain and sent him to jail. Ghaziabad's DCP Rural Surendranath Tiwari said that a case has been registered on the woman's complaint. The victim has lived in different places. The crime scenes have also been stated to be at various locations. Police are recording the victim's statement and conducting further investigation. One accused has been arrested and sent to jail. Action will also be taken against the other accused.

stories.title: UP records 25 suicides daily:Love affair-linked deaths jump fourfold in five years; videos emerge as ‘Digital suicide notes’
stories.summary: Around 25 people are committing suicide every day in UP. Where 4,804 total suicide cases were registered in 2020, this number increased to 9,180 in 2024. This information came to light after assessing recent and old reports of the National Crime Record Bureau (NCRB). Suicide cases after a failed love have increased 4 times in the last 5 years. 283 suicide cases due to love relationships came to light in 2020. In 2024, the number of such cases became 1,120. Read the special report Family problems are the biggest reason for suicide Looking at NCRB data, between 2012 and 2016, a total of 923 people lost their lives due to failure in love. From 2017 to 2021, this figure increased to 1754. Meanwhile, from 2022 to 2024, in just 3 years, this number reached 2746. In the year 2024, 1120 deaths were recorded due to love affairs, which is the highest annual figure so far. Meanwhile, the biggest reason for suicide is family problems. In UP, from 2020 to 2024, the highest 33%, that is one-third of people, committed suicide due to family reasons. These cases are increasing every year. In 2020, suicide cases were 1952. In 2021, this number increased to 2,235, while in 2022 it became 3,134. In 2023, 3,621 and in 2024, 3,071 people committed suicide due to family reasons. Trend of recording videos before suicide increases In the past few years, a trend has emerged of committing suicide while recording videos or live streaming (live telecast on social media). Before suicide, the deceased records their problems on camera. After this, they take their life by hanging or other means. These videos go viral on social media. In 70% cases people hanged themselves Data shows that hanging remains the most prevalent method of suicide. In 2020, there were 2,900 cases of hanging, which reached 6,371 in 2024. Out of a total of 9,180 suicide cases in 2024, 69.4% involved hanging. However, the method of taking one's life by consuming sleeping pills has also increased rapidly. From 2020 to 2024, such cases have increased by 232%. Unemployment and poverty have also increased concerns about suicide cases According to NCRB data, there has also been an increase in suicides due to unemployment and poverty. Between 2012 and 2016, 314 people committed suicide due to unemployment. In the next 5 years, this number became 625. During 2022 to 2024, that is, in just 3 years, the figure has reached 528. Similarly, the figure of deaths due to poverty was also 160 from 2012 to 2017. In the next 5 years, it reached 441. After that, from 2022 to 2024, that is, in just 3 years, the figure crossed 444. Now, let's know what the expert says Senior Consultant Psychiatrist Dr. Krishna Mishra explains - Love, lust, and attraction are three different things. However, often people are unable to understand the difference between them. Sometimes a person considers lust or attraction as love and becomes dependent on it. In this situation, as soon as rejection comes from the other side, the person is unable to manage it. Today's parenting also fails to teach how to manage rejection. Children are never refused anything. In such a situation, when they face rejection regarding their feelings, they are unable to tolerate it. Clinical psychologist Dyutima Sharma says that when love affairs break up, people experience the same kind of pain as when someone dies. However, in the case of death, people understand that things were not in their hands. But when relationships break, especially when someone has cheated, it often becomes difficult to overcome this grief. In such a situation, people's confidence in themselves decreases. How to identify if someone is thinking of committing suicide? Senior Consultant Psychiatrist Dr. Krishna Mishra explains - If a person who was previously happy has suddenly changed their behavior, then attention needs to be paid to them. Such a person reduces conversation and meeting people. They stay alone, and their productivity drops. Sometimes they also talk about dying. If such changes are seen in someone's behavior, then one should immediately talk to a mental health expert. What is the solution? Due to the internet and social media, the difference between love and attraction has diminished nowadays. Earlier, the scope of eyes was limited, but now people consider likes and comments on posts as love. That's why it's important to understand whether the feeling inside you is love, lust, or attraction. For this, you need to work on your mental health. You need to practice behaviors that keep the mind calm. Parents also have a big responsibility in this, so that children get the right understanding of love from home itself.

stories.title: 84 PCS officers transferred in UP:Varanasi ADM Alok Kumar, who hit hotel owner with his head, posted to Sultanpur
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government led by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, transferred 84 Provincial Civil Service officers (PCS) late on Thursday evening as part of a major administrative reshuffle. The transfers largely involve officers posted at the Additional District Magistrate (ADM) level, who have now been assigned new responsibilities across districts, development authorities, municipal corporations and state-level departments. Varanasi ADM Alok Verma posted to Sultanpur Alok Kumar Verma, who was serving as ADM City in Varanasi, has been appointed Chief Revenue Officer of Sultanpur. Alok Kumar Verma had come into the spotlight in 2024 after an altercation in Varanasi in which he allegedly headbutted hotel owner Zafar Ali Khan and his brother Khurshid. Jhansi ADM appointed law university registrar Varun Kumar Pandey, previously posted as ADM in Jhansi, has been appointed Registrar of Dr Rajendra Prasad National Law University in Prayagraj. Meanwhile, Jyotsna Yadav has been removed from the post of Secretary of the Khurja-Bulandshahr Development Authority. She has now been appointed Registrar of Atal Bihari Vajpayee Medical University. Who was sent where, see the complete transfer list Transfers linked to completion of three-year tenure According to government sources, the reshuffle was carried out to reassign officers who had completed their normal three-year tenure at their current postings. Several officers have been shifted to development authorities, municipal corporations and state-level departments as part of the exercise. Officials said the move is aimed at bringing fresh administrative energy to district governance, urban development bodies and other government departments. The transfer orders have come into effect immediately, and all officers concerned have been directed to assume charge at their new postings at the earliest.

stories.title: Parag milk prices rise by Rs 2 per litre:Revised rates effective from May 15 evening in UP; Amul hiked prices a day earlier
stories.summary: After Amul, Uttar Pradesh’s largest dairy brand Parag has also increased milk prices by Rs 2 per litre. The revised prices will come into effect from the evening of May 15. The price of full cream milk has been raised from Rs 69 per litre to Rs 71 per litre. Instructions regarding the price revision were issued by Parag’s General Manager on Thursday. Prices of all milk variants, including full cream, super standard, toned and standard milk, have been increased. Parag Dairy had last raised milk prices in May 2025, when rates were also increased by up to Rs 2 per litre. The latest hike comes after nearly a year. Parag still cheaper than Amul and Mother Dairy The price of Parag Gold’s six-litre pack has been increased from Rs 420 to Rs 425. The 500 ml pack will now cost Rs 36 instead of Rs 35. Despite the increase, Parag milk remains Rs 1 per litre cheaper than both Mother Dairy and Amul. Toned milk and tea-special milk prices revised The price of Parag Toned Milk’s five-litre pack has been raised from Rs 285 to Rs 290. The one-litre pack will now cost Rs 59 instead of Rs 57, while the 500 ml pack price has been revised from Rs 29 to Rs 30. The price of a 500 ml pack of Standard Milk has increased from Rs 32 to Rs 33. Meanwhile, the five-litre standard milk pack has seen the steepest hike of Rs 10 and will now cost Rs 300 instead of Rs 290. The price of a one-litre pack of Tea-Special Milk has also been raised from Rs 64 to Rs 66. Rising transport costs cited as key reason A senior Parag official said nearly 30% of operational costs are linked to transportation. This includes both milk delivery and procurement from dairy farmers. According to the official, transport expenses have been steadily rising over the past several months. The official also said that after Amul increased prices, pressure mounted on other dairy companies to revise rates as well. Amul and Mother Dairy raised prices a day earlier On Wednesday, Amul and Mother Dairy had also increased milk prices by up to Rs 2 per litre. The revised rates of both companies came into effect from Thursday, May 14. According to the Gujarat Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation, the decision was taken due to rising costs of cattle feed, packaging and fuel. Amul said the latest hike amounts to an increase of between 2.5% and 3.5%. The company had last revised milk prices in May 2025, while Mother Dairy had increased prices earlier in April 2025. stories.summary: Prateek Yadav Death Case Reaches NHRC: समाजवादी पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष अखिलेश यादव के छोटे भाई और भाजपा नेता अपर्णा यादव के पति प्रतीक यादव की संदिग्ध मौत का मामला अब राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग (NHRC) तक पहुंच गया है। प्रतीक यादव की मौत को लेकर लगातार उठ रहे सवालों के बीच अब एक गैर सरकारी संस्था (NGO) ने हत्या की आशंका जताते हुए मामले की स्वतंत्र और निष्पक्ष जांच की मांग की है। मानवाधिकार के लिए काम करने वाली संस्था डीके फाउंडेशन ने NHRC में शिकायत दाखिल कर इस मामले को बेहद गंभीर बताया है। संस्था का कहना है कि प्रतीक यादव की मौत सामान्य नहीं लगती और शरीर पर मिले कथित चोट के निशान कई सवाल खड़े करते हैं। NGO ने मांग की है कि मामले की जांच के लिए तत्काल विशेष जांच दल (SIT) गठित किया जाए और पूरी जांच को राजनीतिक या प्रशासनिक प्रभाव से मुक्त रखा जाए।

stories.title: Businessman’s daughter plans robbery at her own home:Opens digital lock for boyfriend in Moradabad; gang took away Rs 1.2 crore at gunpoint
stories.summary: Police have solved the robbery of Rs 1.20 crore in cash and six tolas of gold jewellery from the house of a brass businessman in Moradabad. According to police, the crime was masterminded by the businessman’s daughter along with her boyfriend, with whom she had been in a relationship for the past eight years. The couple allegedly wanted to marry, but the businessman and his family opposed the relationship. Police said the two then conspired to rob the house with the help of the boyfriend’s seven friends, all of whom are B.Pharm students at the same college. The daughter allegedly provided complete details of the house to her boyfriend and had also handed over a duplicate key to the main gate around a month before the robbery. On the night of May 11, she allegedly opened the digital lock from inside the house by pressing a button, allowing the robbers to enter easily. The accused then allegedly held the businessman’s son at gunpoint and escaped with cash and jewellery in two cars. Police have so far arrested five accused, including the boyfriend. Officers recovered Rs 47.24 lakh in cash, several illegal weapons and two cars from them. Three other accused remain absconding. The incident took place in the Akbar Compound area under Nagphani police station limits in Moradabad. How the robbery took place Brass trader Mohammad Imran lives in Akbar Compound with his wife Seema and four children, Areeb (26), Arkaan (23), Ariba (21) and Aliza (19). According to police, at around 3.40 am on May 11, eight armed men entered the house and looted Rs 1.20 crore in cash along with six tolas of jewellery. The robbers allegedly held Imran’s son hostage at gunpoint before fleeing with the valuables. Police became suspicious because the house had a digital locking system, yet there were no signs of forced entry or damage to the lock, suggesting possible insider involvement. Police traced accused through CCTV and surveillance Moradabad SSP Satpal Antil said police launched an investigation immediately after the robbery. Using CCTV footage and electronic surveillance, investigators reached Imran’s daughter Ariba, who was later detained and questioned. During interrogation, Ariba allegedly disclosed details about all those involved in the robbery and admitted that she had opened the digital lock from inside the house. Police subsequently arrested Ariba, her boyfriend Arshad Warsi, and three others, Kuldeep (26), Ravi Kumar (26) and Nikki (21). According to police, all the accused except Ariba are students pursuing B.Pharm at the Institute of Foreign Trade and Management in Moradabad. Ariba studied up to Class 12 and stayed at home. 8-year relationship led to conspiracy, police claim SSP Satpal Antil said Ariba and Arshad Warsi, a resident of Amroha district, had been in a relationship for the last seven to eight years. The couple allegedly wanted to marry and live together, but faced opposition from Ariba’s family. Police said the two then decided to elope and settle separately, for which they needed money. According to investigators, Ariba told Arshad that her father was a wealthy businessman and kept large amounts of cash at home. Police claim Arshad then suggested stealing or robbing the cash so they could live comfortably in future. Ariba allegedly agreed, after which the two planned the robbery together. Duplicate key made for main gate During questioning, Ariba allegedly told police that she had arranged a duplicate key for the main gate about a month before the incident and handed it over to Arshad. According to police, the plan was that Arshad would use the duplicate key to enter through the main gate, while Ariba would unlock the second digital lock from inside the house. This would allow Arshad and his associates to enter the house without attracting attention. House surveyed several times before robbery Police said Arshad conducted reconnaissance of the businessman’s house multiple times before the robbery. The gang allegedly finalised May 11 for carrying out the crime. At around 3.40 am, Arshad and his seven accomplices reached the house. After entering through the main gate, Ariba allegedly opened the internal digital locks from inside. The accused then entered the businessman’s room and allegedly carried out the robbery at gunpoint. stories.title: Prateek Yadav’s viscera to undergo poison and drug tests:NGO alleges murder, says probe will reveal exact cause of death
stories.summary: The death case of Prateek Yadav, younger brother of Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, has now reached the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC). A Rampur-based NGO, DK Foundation, has raised questions over the circumstances surrounding Prateek’s death and demanded an impartial investigation. Foundation president Danish Khan told Dainik Bhaskar that Prateek’s death was “not natural” and that the organisation suspected murder. “We have taken suo motu cognisance of the matter and demanded a judicial inquiry,” he said. Foundation lists three key demands The organisation has placed three major demands before authorities- 1. Formation of an SIT- The foundation has demanded the immediate constitution of a Special Investigation Team (SIT) to probe the case. 2. Judicial custody of CCTV footage- It has sought judicial custody of CCTV footage from Lucknow Civil Hospital and the route connected to the incident. 3. Central forensic examination- The NGO has demanded that forensic testing be conducted by the Central Forensic Science Laboratory (CFSL), free from any alleged state influence. Earlier, SP MLA Ravidas Mehrotra had also raised doubts over the death, saying, “This is not a normal death. He may have been poisoned.” He demanded an inquiry by a retired High Court judge. Post-mortem cites cardio-respiratory collapse According to the post-mortem report, Prateek’s death was caused by sudden failure of the heart and lungs, medically termed “cardio-respiratory collapse”. Doctors stated that this occurred due to a clot in the main blood vessel supplying blood to the lungs, a condition known as “massive pulmonary thromboembolism”. The condition develops when a blood clot formed elsewhere in the body, commonly in the legs, travels to the lungs and blocks blood circulation. However, to determine what caused the clots in Prateek’s body, his viscera has been preserved and sent to a forensic laboratory in Lucknow for examination. What is viscera and why is it important? Forensic expert Ayush Baser explained that after a post-mortem, samples from internal organs are preserved for detailed investigation. These preserved organ samples are known as “viscera”. The samples generally include portions of the stomach, intestines, liver, kidneys and heart. They are preserved in chemicals such as rectified spirit, saturated salt solution, sodium fluoride, glycerol and formalin to prevent decomposition. Ayush Baser said viscera is sent for chemical analysis when the exact cause of death, whether illness, injury or poisoning, remains unclear after the post-mortem. Forensic tests can detect poison, drugs and chemicals He said forensic experts use viscera analysis to identify hidden traces of poison, drugs, alcohol or chemicals inside the body. If the viscera report comes back negative, death is generally attributed to illness or injury rather than poisoning. He added that in criminal investigations, viscera reports are considered crucial legal evidence. Viscera reports can take six months to a year According to Ayush Baser, there is no fixed timeline for viscera reports. He said reports can take anywhere between six months and one year, or even longer, due to the heavy backlog in Uttar Pradesh’s forensic laboratories. However, in highly sensitive or priority cases, reports may be prepared within eight to 10 days. According to the UP Police Technical Services Unit, more than 15,000 viscera reports were pending in forensic laboratories across the state by 2025. In February 2026, the Uttar Pradesh government announced plans to upgrade forensic science laboratories and reduce the backlog. What Prateek’s post-mortem report revealed 1. Massive Pulmonary Thromboembolism Doctors found clots in the main blood vessel carrying blood to the lungs. Such clots usually travel from another part of the body, often the legs, and block circulation in the lungs. The report mentioned reddish-brown clots in the lungs, which caused immediate respiratory and circulatory failure. 2. Cardio-respiratory Collapse This refers to the sudden failure of both the heart and respiratory system. According to the report, oxygen supply to the body stopped because of the lung clot, eventually causing the heart to stop functioning. Other findings mentioned in the post-mortem report 1. Antemortem injuries Doctors found six antemortem injuries on Prateek’s body, meaning injuries sustained before death while he was alive. The injuries were estimated to be between one and seven days old. 2. Contusion and ecchymosis The report noted bruising caused by rupture of blood vessels beneath the skin due to blunt force impact. Red-brown and green-yellow marks were found on the chest and hands. 3. Cyanosis Doctors observed blue or purple discolouration on the lips, ears and nails, indicating severe lack of oxygen in the blood. This condition is medically known as cyanosis. 4. Subarachnoid haemorrhage The report also mentioned bleeding between the layers covering the brain, medically called subarachnoid haemorrhage. Such bleeding is commonly associated with head injury or severe trauma. Heaviness in veins around the temporo-parietal region of the brain was also noted. 5. Edema Swelling caused by fluid accumulation, known as edema, was found in both lower limbs. Doctors noted that such swelling is often linked to heart-related or blood circulation disorders.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:VD Satheesan to become new Kerala CM; Prateek Yadav cremated in Lucknow more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from UP and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day- 1. VD Satheesan named Kerala Chief Minister after days of suspense Congress on Thursday announced VD Satheesan as the next Kerala Chief Minister. The decision was declared in Delhi by AICC leaders after days of speculation over the leadership choice. 2. Prateek Yadav cremated in Lucknow; Akhilesh pays final tribute Akhilesh Yadav’s younger brother Prateek Yadav was cremated on Thursday in Lucknow, with his father-in-law performing the last rites. Akhilesh and Prateek’s two daughters also took part in the funeral rituals. 3. Storms and lightning kill 104 across UP; 2,000 villages face blackout Severe storms, rain and lightning left at least 104 people dead across Uttar Pradesh in 24 hours. Massive disruption was reported in several districts, while a Bareilly man was swept 50 feet into the air with a tin shed during strong winds. 4. Indian cargo ship sinks in Oman Sea after suspected drone strike Gujarat-based cargo vessel ‘Haji Ali’ sank in the Oman Sea after reportedly being hit by a drone or missile-like object. All 14 crew members were rescued safely by the Oman Coast Guard. 5. Allahabad High Court seeks replies from CBI, ED in Rahul Gandhi assets case The Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court directed the CBI, ED and SFIO to submit replies within eight weeks in a case linked to alleged disproportionate assets of Rahul Gandhi. The next hearing is scheduled for July 20. 6. Man kills pregnant wife in Gorakhpur, dies by suicide A man in Gorakhpur allegedly strangled his pregnant wife over repeated disputes before taking his own life. The case surfaced after postmortem findings ruled out initial claims of a double suicide. 7. Wholesale inflation rises to 8.30% amid Iran war disruptions India’s wholesale price inflation rose sharply to 8.30% in April from 3.88% in March, touching a 42-month high. Rising global disruptions linked to the Iran conflict are believed to have pushed up prices. 8. Prateek Yadav suffered two heart attacks within 13 days The death of Prateek Yadav has triggered emotional reactions across Uttar Pradesh, with family members recalling his close bond with late Mulayam Singh Yadav. He had reportedly suffered two heart attacks within 13 days before his death. 9. Scorpio crashes into truck in Banda, four killed on expressway Four members of a businessman’s family died after a Scorpio-N rammed into a cylinder-laden truck on the Bundelkhand Expressway in Banda. A teenage girl was seriously injured, while cranes were used to recover the bodies from the wreckage. 10. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi earns maiden India A call-up Young cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has been named in the India A squad for the upcoming one-day tri-series in Sri Lanka. The tournament will also feature Sri Lanka A and Afghanistan A teams.

CM Yogi makes surprise Delhi visit, meets Amit Shah:Portfolios yet to be allotted to 6 new ministers after cabinet expansion
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath made a sudden visit to Delhi on Thursday and met Union Home Minister Amit Shah at his residence. The meeting took place around 3 pm and lasted nearly half an hour. This was the first meeting between Yogi Adityanath and Amit Shah after the recent expansion of the Uttar Pradesh cabinet. On May 10, six new ministers were inducted into the cabinet, while two existing ministers were promoted. However, portfolios are yet to be allocated. Political circles are speculating that the meeting focused on the distribution of ministerial portfolios. Sources said the Chief Minister may later meet Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and BJP national president Nitin Naveen during his Delhi visit. Discussion likely centred on 2027 UP Assembly elections The meeting with the BJP leadership is also being linked to preparations for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. According to party sources, after attempting to achieve regional, caste and social balance through the induction of new ministers, the Chief Minister is now looking to redistribute portfolios accordingly. The meeting is being seen as part of that exercise. Organisational changes within the BJP are also expected soon, and discussions on the issue are believed to have taken place. Deadlock continues over allocation of portfolios Although offices have been allotted to the newly inducted ministers, portfolios have not yet been assigned. Sources said Amit Shah, regarded as the BJP’s principal strategist, may have to intervene to resolve the deadlock. The eight newly appointed or promoted ministers have remained without portfolios for five days. Uttar Pradesh currently has 60 ministers, including the Chief Minister and two Deputy Chief Ministers. stories.title: Man swept away 50 feet into air recalls ordeals:'Never thought I would survive,’ says UP’s Nanhe
stories.summary: “I was holding the rope to stop the tin shed from flying away when a powerful gust lifted both me and the shed into the air. I was thrown nearly 50 feet high. I never thought I would survive.” These were the words of 50-year-old Nanhe Miyan from Bareilly, who was seriously injured after being swept away during a violent storm on Wednesday evening. The incident took place in Bamiana village, where Nanhe Miyan was trying to secure the tin shed of a wedding hall during heavy winds. He was holding a rope attached to the shed when a strong gust carried him away along with the structure. He was flung through the air before falling into a nearby field, suffering multiple injuries. Family members rushed him to hospital, where doctors confirmed fractures in one arm and one leg, along with injuries to other parts of his body. Nanhe Miyan works as an e-rickshaw driver. His family includes his wife Anjum Begum (45), two daughters and three sons. His eldest son is 17 years old. ‘I thought the storm would blow the shed away’ Recalling the incident, Nanhe Miyan said he had gone to collect goods from the wedding hall in his e-rickshaw on Wednesday evening when the weather suddenly worsened. “The storm was extremely strong and the tin shed started coming loose. I thought if I did not hold it, the wind would blow it away,” he said. “I immediately grabbed the rope tied to the shed, but the force of the wind lifted me into the air. I rose nearly 50 feet and landed in a field around 100 metres away. I suffered several injuries after hitting the ground.” Entire incident captured on mobile phone The dramatic incident was also recorded on a mobile phone. At the time Nanhe Miyan was swept into the air, a local resident, Razan Ansari, was filming the storm on his mobile phone. The entire sequence was captured on camera. Razan said he lives near Jama Masjid and had stepped outside to record the weather because the evening sky looked striking during the storm. “While recording, I suddenly saw Nanhe Miyan flying in the air with the tin shed. I immediately captured the incident on video,” he said. He later uploaded the video on social media, where it quickly went viral. SDM visits hospital, directs doctors to ensure proper treatment After receiving information about the incident, Aonla SDM Vidushi Singh visited the hospital on Thursday to enquire about Nanhe Miyan’s condition. Nanhe Miyan is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital in Devchara. The SDM spoke to doctors about his medical condition and instructed hospital authorities to ensure he received proper treatment.

stories.title: 50 years of Annakili: The film that launched Ilaiyaraaja’s career
stories.summary: Fifty years have passed like a fleeting moment, but the songs of Annakili continue to haunt generations of music lovers. With the film’s release began the extraordinary musical journey of Ilaiyaraaja, whose career would later rise to unparalleled heights. Gangai Amaran, who worked closely with his brother during the composing sessions and served as the rhythm guitarist for the film, recalls those memorable days with B. Kolappan. “The higher octaves in the humming of the song ‘Annakili Unnai Theduthey’ symbolically foreshadowed the great heights Ilaiyaraaja was destined to achieve,” he said.

stories.title: Sex racket operating behind Dehradun school busted:Women brought from UP, Meghalaya and Haryana; condoms, liquor bottles found during raid
stories.summary: Police have arrested two men and rescued three women after uncovering an alleged sex racket operating from a room behind a private school in the Cantonment area of Dehradun. The raid was carried out in Kishan Nagar Extension after local residents noticed frequent movement of young men and women near the room and informed members of the Hindu Raksha Dal. Police were later alerted and conducted a raid at the premises. According to CO City Swapnil Muyal, two men and three women were found during the raid. Police said one woman was from Meerut in Uttar Pradesh, another from Faridabad in Haryana and the third from Meghalaya. Police said a Swift car recovered from the spot has also been seized. Condoms, liquor bottles found at spot Police said condom packets, liquor bottles, water bottles and snack packets were found inside and around the room located behind the school building. Officials suspect the accused used regular school activities to avoid attracting attention from local residents and police. Photos related to the incident Women allege they were forced into prostitution One of the rescued women told police that the accused had promised them jobs in a company before allegedly sexually exploiting them and recording videos. She alleged they were later threatened with the videos being made public and forced into prostitution. Another woman from Meghalaya alleged that her boyfriend had brought her to Dehradun and introduced her to the accused. She claimed she was drawn into the trade with the promise of money and alcohol. Police said the room had been rented to a man from Rajasthan and the occupants were staying there without police verification. Main accused previously jailed in similar case The arrested men have been identified as Ashish Kumar Pandey, a resident of Vaishali Nagar in Jaipur, and Jung Bahadur, a resident of Janta Colony in Jaipur. Police said preliminary investigation showed that Ashish Pandey had previously been jailed in a prostitution-related case. According to police, the accused allegedly brought women from other states to Dehradun on the pretext of providing employment and later pushed them into prostitution. A case has been registered under Sections 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act. Further investigation is underway. Hindu Raksha Dal alleges larger network Hindu Raksha Dal president Lalit Sharma claimed the group had been monitoring suspicious activity in the area for some time before informing police. He alleged that the two arrested men were not the masterminds and claimed another suspect was absconding. Police have not officially confirmed this claim. Sharma also demanded action against the school management, alleging the racket was operating from within the school premises without checks.

stories.title: Scorpio rams into truck in Banda, 4 killed:Bodies recovered with the help of a crane; businessman’s family was enroute to Mahoba
stories.summary: Four people, including a businessman, his mother and grandmother, were killed after a speeding Scorpio-N rammed into a cylinder-laden DCM truck on the Bundelkhand Expressway in Uttar Pradesh’s Banda district. A 16-year-old girl was seriously injured in the crash. The impact was so severe that nearly half of the SUV went underneath the truck. Several engine components broke apart and pierced the chest of the driver. Two cranes were later used to retrieve the trapped bodies from the mangled vehicle. The accident took place around 9 am on Thursday near Hathaura village under Kotwali Dehat police station limits, at kilometre marker 47.8 on the expressway. The family was travelling from Azamgarh to Kabrai in Mahoba district. See pictures of the accident- Family returning after offering prayers at family deity shrine Ajit Vishwakarma (38), a resident of Ramgarh village under Jianpur police station area in Azamgarh, lived with his family in Kabrai town of Mahoba district, where he ran a tyre shop. According to police, Ajit had travelled to Azamgarh to offer prayers to the family deity along with his mother Premshila (55), grandmother Chandravati (80), aunt Nisha Vishwakarma (40), and 16-year-old sister Riya. They were travelling in a friend’s Scorpio-N vehicle. The family left Azamgarh for Mahoba at around 11.30 pm on Wednesday. Driver reportedly dozed off after 450-km journey After travelling nearly 450 km, the vehicle reached near Hathaura village in Banda at around 9 am on Thursday. Police said Ajit, who was driving the SUV, allegedly fell asleep at the wheel. The Scorpio-N then went out of control and rammed into the cylinder-laden truck moving ahead on the expressway. The collision crushed the nearly 15-foot-long SUV to almost six feet. All three airbags near the steering wheel, roof and seatbelt deployed but burst during the impact. Engine parts pierced driver’s chest Residents rushed to the spot after hearing the loud crash and informed the police. Eyewitnesses said broken engine components had pierced Ajit’s body. Due to the bursting airbags, Ajit and his mother Premshila, who was seated in the front, suffered severe head injuries. Grandmother Chandravati and aunt Nisha, seated in the rear, were trapped inside the wreckage. Riya, who was also seated at the back, sustained serious injuries and was rushed to hospital. Two cranes used to retrieve trapped bodies Police said two bodies trapped in the rear section were removed after opening the SUV’s rear door. Ajit’s body, however, was wedged between the driver’s seat and the engine compartment. The body of Chandravati was also trapped between the dashboard and the seat. Two cranes were called to the spot to recover the bodies. One crane lifted the truck while another pushed the crushed SUV backwards, after which rescue teams managed to pull out Ajit’s body. Chandravati’s body was then recovered from the wreckage. SP says case to be registered against truck driver Banda Superintendent of Police Palash Bansal said four people had died in the accident and the victims’ relatives had been informed. He said the injured girl was in shock and unable to give a statement about the incident. She was later referred to Kanpur for treatment. The SP added that police have initiated legal proceedings and further investigation into the accident is underway.

stories.title: Commissioner on bicycle, Ayush Minister reaches office in EV car:Awareness rally taken out on e-scooter following PM's appeal, MLA also rides bicycle
stories.summary: Amidst the growing energy crisis in the world, the impact of PM Modi's appeal is now being seen in UP as well. Moradabad Commissioner Anjaneya Kumar Singh (IAS) left his luxury car and reached office by bicycle. Uttar Pradesh government's AYUSH Minister Dr. Dayashankar Mishra Dayalu has started using an electric vehicle (EV) single car. Meanwhile, Varanasi MLA Saurabh Srivastava went out on a bicycle for area visits. During this, he appealed to the public to use bicycles and walk. Actually, late Tuesday night, CM Yogi Adityanath had appealed to ministers and MLAs to use public transport one day a week. BJP workers also took out a rally on e-scooters to make Varanasi residents aware and reduce petrol-diesel consumption. In the rally, workers holding flags raised slogans in support of Narendra Modi. See 4 pictures... Minister requests people to use EVs In Varanasi, AYUSH Minister Dr. Dayashankar Mishra 'Dayalu' appealed to the residents of Kashi and the state to adopt electric vehicles and fuel-saving measures as much as possible. In compliance with the directives of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Dr. Dayashankar Mishra Dayalu has started using an electric vehicle (EV) single car. He said that public participation is extremely necessary for building a clean and green Uttar Pradesh. Dr. Dayashankar Mishra 'Dayalu' said - Environmental protection, pollution control and fuel conservation are the biggest needs of today's time. Inspired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi's "Green India" vision and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's environment-friendly policies, he has started using EV vehicles. In the coming time, he will also adopt many other environment-friendly changes in his daily life, so that a positive message about fuel and clean environment reaches society. Only when public representatives themselves take initiative in this direction will widespread awareness be created in society and this campaign can take the form of a mass movement. Varanasi MLA rode a bicycle Varanasi MLA Saurabh Srivastava toured the area on a bicycle. He said - In view of the war, PM Modi appealed to save resources and diesel-petrol. He himself reduced the vehicles in his convoy. Taking inspiration from PM Modi, I have also started cycling instead of using a car. Right now I am going for an area tour. My request to everyone is that if you have to go a short distance within the city, then walk or go by bicycle. This is good for both your health and the country. Jai Hind Jai Bharat. Awareness rally taken out on e-scooters in Varanasi In Varanasi, BJP has started an awareness campaign regarding petrol and diesel by riding electric scooters. BJP workers reached out to the masses regarding PM Modi's appeal. Workers appealed for consumption of petrol and diesel as per requirement. Garlanding and with folded hands, appealing to people to use petrol and diesel minimally. Support us in the nation's interest. Stickers of PM's appeal were also pasted at petrol pumps and public places. In the rally, workers raised slogans of Modi ji's path for the nation's sake. Yesterday Yogi took major decisions amid the energy crisis PM Modi said for 2 consecutive days - Reduce the use of petrol-diesel Prime Minister Narendra Modi said from a public platform on May 10 and 11 that in today's times, the use of petrol-diesel and gas will have to be reduced. Due to the impact of the war going on in the neighborhood, petrol-diesel prices have increased manifold across the world. India is more affected by this global crisis. We don't have large oil wells. Today we need measures like work from home. In cities where there is metro, people should use the metro. He said that earlier when there was war, people used to donate gold. Today there is no need for donation, but we have to take this pledge today that for the next 1 year, whatever program there is, don't buy gold. This will also save foreign exchange. stories.title: CBI, ED summoned in Rahul Gandhi assets case:High Court seeks response within 8 weeks
stories.summary: The Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court has sought responses from multiple central agencies in connection with allegations of disproportionate assets against Rahul Gandhi. The court directed the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Enforcement Directorate (ED), and the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO), along with other concerned departments, to file their replies within eight weeks. The next hearing in the matter has been scheduled for July 20. The order was passed by a division bench comprising Justice Rajesh Singh Chauhan and Justice Zafeer Ahmad while hearing a petition filed by S. Vignesh Shishir. The petitioner also requested that the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), the Revenue Department under the Finance Ministry, and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs be made parties to the case. The court accepted the request. Petitioner claims complaints already submitted to CBI, ED During the hearing, counsel representing the CBI informed the court that the petitioner’s complaint had already been received and that a response regarding the inquiry would be submitted by the next hearing date. Similarly, the ED told the court that the allegations were being examined after receipt of the complaint and that a progress report would be filed during the next hearing. The court observed that if the complaint had already been received, the concerned agencies should verify the allegations in accordance with the law and take necessary action. The SFIO also sought additional time to submit its response, which was granted by the court. All parties have been directed to file their affidavits within the stipulated timeframe. Court orders records to be kept in sealed cover Considering the sensitivity of the matter, the High Court also ordered that the complete case records and related documents be preserved in a sealed cover. BJP worker from Karnataka filed the petition The petition was filed by Karnataka-based BJP worker S. Vignesh Shishir. The petitioner has alleged that Rahul Gandhi and members of his family possess assets disproportionate to their declared income. The plea has sought an impartial investigation by central agencies into the allegations. During the upcoming hearing, the court will first examine the maintainability of the petition — determining whether the plea is legally fit for detailed consideration. Further legal proceedings will depend on the outcome of that assessment.

stories.title: Pregnant woman murdered after dispute over clothing:Husband kills wife, then ends life; WhatsApp chats reveal repeated arguments
stories.summary: A shocking case of domestic violence has emerged from Gorakhpur, where a man allegedly strangled his pregnant wife to death over disputes related to her clothing choices before dying by suicide. The incident came to light after postmortem findings contradicted initial assumptions of a double suicide. Police said the husband was upset over his wife wearing lower-T-shirts and what he considered “modern clothes.” WhatsApp chats recovered from the couple’s phones allegedly revealed repeated arguments over her lifestyle and dressing preferences. The incident took place in the Belghat police station area of Gorakhpur. Bodies found inside locked room According to police, the couple had married for love around six months ago. On Tuesday morning, family members became suspicious after the room remained locked for an unusually long time. When the door was eventually broken open, the husband’s body was found hanging from a ceiling fan, while the pregnant wife’s body was lying on the bed. Foam was reportedly coming out of her mouth. Initially, police suspected it to be a case of suicide. However, the case took a dramatic turn after the postmortem report confirmed that the woman had died due to strangulation. Investigators then examined the couple’s mobile phones, social media accounts and WhatsApp chats, which allegedly revealed the reason behind the murder. WhatsApp chats revealed repeated arguments Police said the chats showed ongoing tension between the couple over lifestyle differences and clothing. In one message, the wife, Nikhat, allegedly told her husband Shadab: “You never take me out anywhere. You never buy anything for me. I am not a girl who can remain confined inside a house.” In response, Shadab reportedly wrote: “Girls from our community do not wear such clothes. If you want to live with me, you will have to stop wearing lower-T-shirts at home.” Police say relationship had been under stress According to SP South Dinesh Puri, the case initially appeared to be suicide, but the postmortem report and digital evidence revealed a different sequence of events. “A husband and wife were found dead inside a house. Initially, it appeared to be a suicide case. But the postmortem report and WhatsApp chats exposed the truth. The husband first killed his wife and then died by suicide by hanging himself,” he said. Police investigations further revealed that the relationship had been under stress for several days. “Nikhat was raised in Mumbai and was unable to adjust to the village environment. Tensions between the couple had increased significantly,” the officer added. According to investigators, Nikhat also taunted Shadab for being unemployed and having an orthodox mindset, which further worsened the relationship.
