stories.title: Oops!... Pak did it again: The 'deny, deflect, get caught' pattern repeats
stories.summary: Pakistan's history of 'oops' moments, from allegedly harboring Iranian aircraft to denying terrorist camps, has eroded its credibility on the global stage. Decades of strategic ambiguity and carefully calibrated deniability have created a trust deficit, making its diplomatic assurances met with skepticism and every crisis a potential international embarrassment.

stories.title: AIADMK internal crisis deepens: EPS removes rebel leaders from party posts for backing Tamil Nadu CM Vijay in floor test
stories.summary: AIADMK's internal conflict escalated as party chief Palaniswami expelled the rebel leaders. These leaders had backed Tamil Nadu CM Vijay during a crucial trust vote on the assembly floor. The move follows accusations of weakening the party's anti-DMK stance and exploring alliances. This leadership struggle intensifies ahead of future elections.

stories.title: NASA confirms School bus-sized asteroid 2026 JH2 to pass very close to Earth
Mexico City’s underground secret world: Ancient temples, ritual skulls and a lost civilisation still hidden beneath modern streets
The $1.8 billion pivot: How Michael Bloomberg’s historic gift rewrote the rules of college access
stories.summary: Michael Bloomberg's $1.8 billion donation to Johns Hopkins University in 2018 revolutionised higher education by funding need-blind admissions. This historic gift eliminated financial barriers for talented students, allowing them to pursue education based on merit, not wealth. The endowment ensures a lasting legacy of opportunity, empowering future generations to excel and contribute to society without the burden of overwhelming debt.

stories.title: The $22 million mystery: Why a secret donor handed a small Canadian hospital the gift of a lifetime
stories.summary: A remarkable $22 million donation to Yarmouth Hospital Foundation in Nova Scotia has transformed local healthcare. The anonymous donor's gift, intended for perpetual funding through investments, ensures over $1 million annually for patient benefits. This unprecedented act of generosity shifts focus from immediate needs to long-term planning, offering a powerful example of quiet philanthropy's lasting impact on regional communities.

stories.title: Archaeologists found a hidden 1800s whisky distillery deep in the Scottish Highlands
NEET UG paper leak case: CBI arrests five accused, raids multiple locations
stories.summary: The CBI has arrested five individuals and launched nationwide searches in connection with alleged irregularities and a paper leak for the NEET UG-2026 examination. The investigation follows a complaint from the Union education ministry, with charges including criminal conspiracy and cheating. The NTA had previously cancelled the exam, affecting nearly 23 lakh candidates, due to suspected circulation of leaked questions.

stories.title: Kash Patel grilled over allegations of 'excessive drinking': 'If you want to pop bottles...'
Evening news wrap: Prateek Yadav’s autopsy reveals cause of death; CM Vijay revokes astrologer’s OSD appointment & more
12 years, 12 judges, 2 favourable orders, RTI applicant yet to get info
stories.summary: After a decade-long legal battle, the Delhi High Court has ordered the National Medical Commission to provide information on former MCI president Dr. Ketan Desai, sought via an RTI application. The court rejected the NMC's plea to reapply, emphasizing transparency and fairness in disclosing details of a corruption complaint and registration status.

stories.title: 'Don't you understand the extent of our victory?' Vijay lambasts DMK after floor test win
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay's government won a trust vote with 144 MLAs supporting it. Following the victory, Vijay penned an open letter to the public, criticizing the opposition DMK for attempting to undermine his administration. He highlighted his party's electoral performance and commitment to secular values, while accusing the DMK of hypocrisy in coalition politics.

stories.title: Jashanpreet Singh jailed for over 5 years in California after police seized illegal weapons
From the cockpit: Pilots decode questions on flight delays, weather
The Dragon and the Dealmaker: Tariff warrior Trump arrives in Beijing as a trade pilgrim
UK police recover bodies of three women from sea off Brighton beach
After PM Modi’s austerity call, Amit Shah, BJP CMs cut convoy size to save fuel
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi's austerity drive to cut fuel consumption has prompted a wave of similar measures across the government. Union ministers, chief ministers, and governors are significantly reducing convoy sizes and encouraging public transport. This initiative aims to curb unnecessary travel and promote economical fuel usage nationwide.

stories.title: Not dead yet: One state at a time — Why 'Congress-mukt Bharat' may never become a reality
'EPS has no such idea': Rebel AIADMK MLA Shanmugam turns 'betrayer' charge on party chief
stories.summary: AIADMK faces a severe internal crisis as a faction of MLAs, led by C.V. Shanmugam, openly rebelled against party chief Edappadi Palaniswami. They allege EPS explored aligning with the DMK and abandoned the party's core anti-DMK stance.

stories.title: Bernard Arnault’s simple billionaire business lesson that most companies forget under pressure
stories.summary: Bernard Arnault, CEO of LVMH, champions a long-term vision for business success. He advises against fixating on quarterly results, stressing that patience and quality build lasting brand value. This approach fosters trust and customer loyalty, crucial for enduring appeal. Companies prioritizing short-term gains risk damaging their reputation and future. Arnault's philosophy offers a sustainable path to outperforming peers financially.

stories.title: The one Google rule, 'focus on the user', that helped build a trillion-dollar company
stories.summary: Google's meteoric rise is attributed to its core belief: 'Focus on the user and all else will follow.' This simple yet powerful principle guided product design, prioritizing user satisfaction over immediate business gains. By minimizing friction and enhancing interactions, Google fostered loyalty and drove growth, proving that user-centricity is a potent business strategy.

stories.title: Assam cabinet clears draft UCC Bill, to be tabled in Assembly on May 26
stories.summary: Assam's cabinet has approved the Uniform Civil Code Bill, slated for introduction in the Assembly on May 26. This move aligns with the BJP's commitment to a common set of civil laws for marriage, divorce, and inheritance, aiming for legal uniformity across communities. The state government emphasises prioritising Assam's identity and development agenda while enacting this significant legislation.

stories.title: Mulayam Singh Yadav's son Prateek poisoned? SP leader makes shock claim
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Ravidas Mehrotra alleged that Prateek Yadav's death was not normal, suggesting poison as a possible cause due to reported bruises and his healthy lifestyle. Prateek Yadav, 38, passed away in Lucknow, with doctors declaring him brought dead at the hospital. His death has prompted condolences from political leaders across party lines.

stories.title: Narco-terror crackdown: NIA arrests Hizb-ul-Mujahideen mastermind Iqbal Singh after extradition from Portugal
stories.summary: National Investigation Agency has arrested Iqbal Singh alias Shera. He is a wanted narco-terrorist. His extradition from Portugal followed diplomatic and legal efforts. Shera is considered the mastermind in a Hizb-ul-Mujahideen terror financing case. His arrest is a significant breakthrough in tackling Pakistan-backed narco-terror networks.

stories.title: Scottish ex-military instructor jailed for over eight years in Ukraine for spying for Russia
Hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship: What next for UK passengers after hospital isolation?
Meet Dr Anand Megalingam: From a tractor driver’s son walking 6 kilometres to school to building a NASA-linked space-tech company
Indian MBA student wins $20,000 Stanford prize for clean energy and emerging markets work
stories.summary: Stanford MBA graduate Sithara Rasheed received the 2026 Stanford Impact Leader Prize for her decade of work in climate finance and innovation. Her efforts at the Rockefeller Foundation, including designing the DART program and leading the eGUIDE initiative, have significantly impacted renewable energy deployment and AI planning in Africa and Asia.

stories.title: Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari retains Bhabanipur, the seat where he defeated Mamata, over Nandigram
stories.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has chosen to keep the Bhabanipur seat and will vacate Nandigram, despite winning both in the recent assembly elections. Adhikari, who previously defeated Mamata Banerjee in Nandigram, had challenged her again by contesting from Bhabanipur. He stated his inability to hold MLA positions from two constituencies and has taken his oath from Bhabanipur.

stories.title: ‘She’s luckier than me’: UK woman wins £333,000 lottery prize after husband secretly put her name
5K 30-39 male category: Pace, purpose and podium | Times Internet Half Marathon
Tamil Nadu CM Vijay revokes astrologer's appointment as OSD after allies raise objections
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay has revoked the appointment of his astrologer, Radhan Pandit, as Officer on Special Duty (Political) following opposition criticism. The decision came a day after the appointment, which had drawn objections that personal beliefs should not influence governance. Pandit, a close aide and party spokesperson, was to assist in political coordination and advisory functions.

stories.title: Bengal chief secretary Manoj Kumar Agarwal orders crackdown on illegal toll booths in Bengal
stories.summary: West Bengal's new BJP government has launched a swift crackdown on illegal toll and drop gates across the state. Chief Secretary Manoj Kumar Agarwal issued the directive, ordering immediate closure of all unauthorized collection points. District administrations are tasked with identifying and removing these illegal operations, with a report due by May 15.

stories.title: Wanted drug lord Prabhdeep Singh extradited to India from Azerbaijan
stories.summary: India has successfully extradited fugitive Prabhdeep Singh from Azerbaijan, a key figure in a major international drug investigation. Singh, wanted under an Interpol Red Notice, was brought back by a Delhi Police team. This repatriation, a result of multi-agency efforts, marks a significant win against organized crime and adds to India's growing success in bringing wanted criminals back home.

stories.title: Vijay clears floor test with 144 MLAs backing TVK: How the high-stakes assembly showdown unfolded
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) successfully passed a crucial floor test, securing the support of several parties including a rebel AIADMK faction. This marks the first coalition government led by a new entrant, breaking the decades-long Dravidian political dominance. Vijay's victory solidifies his position as the state's first non-DMK, non-AIADMK chief minister since 1967.

stories.title: Training aircraft crashes near Baramati airport in Maharashtra
stories.summary: A Redbird Aviation training plane experienced an incident near Baramati airport during a solo flight on Tuesday. The cadet pilot emerged unharmed from the occurrence involving a Tecnam P2008JC aircraft. Redbird confirmed the pilot's safety and stated that authorities are involved in the ongoing assessment and investigation of the event.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia launched secret retaliatory airstrikes on Iran during regional war: Report
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia conducted unpublicized airstrikes on Iran in late March, marking the first direct military action on Iranian soil in retaliation for attacks within the kingdom. This shift in approach followed Iranian strikes on Gulf Cooperation Council states, leading to an informal de-escalation understanding between Riyadh and Tehran.

stories.title: Midnight delivery on remote island, care in Ladakh: 15 nurses get national Florence Nightingale awards
stories.summary: President Droupadi Murmu honored 15 nursing professionals with the National Florence Nightingale Awards 2026 on International Nurses Day. The awards recognized exceptional service, including life-saving deliveries on remote islands and healthcare in high-altitude regions. These nurses were celebrated for their dedication and crucial role in delivering quality healthcare, often under challenging conditions.

stories.title: Pakistan unlikely to abandon proxy war, says former army commander who led the western front in Operation Sindoor
stories.summary: Former Western Army Commander Lt Gen Manoj Katiyar stated Pakistan's military views proxy warfare as a low-cost tool, unlikely to abandon terrorism. He emphasized India's responses must escalate beyond tactical punishment to impose sustained costs, evolving deterrence into compliance. Perception management through information and cyber warfare is crucial for future conflicts, which will be multi-domain.

stories.title: Vijay’s floor test today: Can TVK prove majority? Number game explained
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay faces his first floor test with a slim majority after his TVK party emerged as the single-largest party. Rebel AIADMK MLAs have pledged support, while a court order temporarily bars one TVK MLA from voting. A forgery row also complicates the situation ahead of the crucial assembly vote.

stories.title: Centre Ties Up With 3 States to Boost Drug Safety, Adverse Reaction Reporting
12.4 lakh chemists to join May 20 shutdown, medicine supply may be hit
stories.summary: Nationwide, over 12.4 lakh chemists are set to strike on May 20, protesting online medicine sales and deep discounts. The All India Organisation of Chemists and Druggists highlights patient safety concerns, citing unregulated sales and potential misuse of prescriptions. They demand the withdrawal of specific government relaxations, fearing the impact on local pharmacies and healthcare access.

stories.title: Every Hindu voter waged struggle in WB: Dattatreya Hosabale
stories.summary: RSS leader Dattatreya Hosabale stated that every Hindu voter became a Hindu worker in West Bengal, viewing the assembly polls as a civilisational question. He emphasized that the organization faced hurdles and attacks due to its work for Hindus. Hosabale also advocated for people-to-people contact to improve India-Pakistan ties and dismissed calls to eradicate Sanatan Dharma.

stories.title: Hegseth pushes Trump’s $1.5 trillion defense budget for 2027 as Congress presses Pentagon over Iran war costs
stories.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended President Trump's proposed $1.5 trillion military budget amid congressional scrutiny over the Iran war's escalating costs, now at $29 billion. Lawmakers questioned the strain on weapons stockpiles, while Hegseth acknowledged increased production to support ongoing operations and future needs.

stories.title: Misadventure happens from across border, we’re ready to quell it: Navy chief-designate after Munir’s warning
stories.summary: Responding to Pakistan's warning, Indian Navy chief-designate Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan stated that India is prepared to counter any "misadventure" from across the border, emphasizing that such actions originate from there. He highlighted India's stance against terrorism, particularly from foreign soil, and underscored the Indian Navy's role as the guardian of the increasingly contested Indo-Pacific maritime domain.

stories.title: Who is Maya Higa? Twitch streamer makes history with first-ever TED Talk and standing ovation
stories.summary: Maya Higa made history by becoming the first Twitch streamer to deliver an official TED Talk, earning a standing ovation from the audience in Vancouver. During the speech, she spoke about using livestreaming to inspire animal conservation through her Alveus Animal Sanctuary. Maya revealed her community has raised over $7.5 million for conservation efforts since 2019. Fans and fellow creators praised the emotional moment online, calling it a major milestone for Twitch and digital creators.

stories.title: Rahul 'strongly dissents' on next CBI director's selection; talks concluded in just 5 minutes
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi registered a strong dissent against the CBI director selection process, calling it a "biased exercise" and a "mere formality." He alleged the government denied him crucial information, including candidate appraisal reports, preventing a meaningful role. Gandhi stated he would not be a "rubber stamp" and boycotted the meeting.

stories.title: Kerala CM suspense may end today, Congress wraps up final huddle
stories.summary: Congress leadership is nearing a decision to end Kerala's week-long Chief Minister deadlock after internal party discussions. Senior leaders, including Rahul and Sonia Gandhi, are expected to finalize the successor to the Left Front's decade-long rule. The prolonged uncertainty has somewhat dulled the UDF's election victory, with three prominent figures vying for the top post.

stories.title: 'Oil cos losing Rs 1,000 crore a day': Hike in prices imminent, hints Petroleum minister Hardeep Singh Puri
stories.summary: Public sector oil companies are facing daily losses of Rs 1,000 crore, potentially forcing fuel price hikes soon. Minister Hardeep Singh Puri highlighted significant under-recoveries, warning that companies cannot sustain these losses indefinitely. While elections are not the reason for the freeze, a drop in crude prices or reopening of the Strait of Hormuz could offer relief.

stories.title: PM Modi tells SPG to cut convoy by half, govt depts to adopt austerity measures
stories.summary: PM Modi has significantly reduced his motorcade size, aiming to inspire austerity across the government. The Special Protection Group is implementing this directive, cutting convoy vehicles by half while maintaining security standards. This move, coupled with the PM's call for reduced fuel and gold consumption, signals a broader push for cost-saving measures within ministries and departments.

stories.title: NEET-UG cancelled after 'paper leak', 23 lakh students hit, CBI to probe case
stories.summary: Exam nixed for 1st time since NTA took over in 2019

stories.title: Even Mahabharat would pale: Supreme Court on Kapur spat
stories.summary: A protracted property dispute between Sunjay Kapur's mother and wife has prompted the Supreme Court to appoint former CJI D Y Chandrachud as mediator. The apex court noted the legal battle's intensity, comparing it to the Mahabharat. A fresh plea alleges circumvention of a previous order, with the court set to hear the matter further.

stories.title: Monsoon may hit Andamans this week: IMD
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department has launched an AI-enabled monsoon forecasting system offering localized weather information up to four weeks in advance for farmers. A pilot service for Uttar Pradesh provides high-resolution rainfall forecasts at 1km resolution for up to 10 days, utilizing advanced AI and observational data.

stories.title: 'People's will through lawmakers can bring religious reforms': Supreme Court
stories.summary: Constitutional courts should be extremely reluctant to alter religious practices, a nine-judge Supreme Court bench cautioned. Only the will of the people, expressed through elected representatives in Parliament and assemblies, can bring about reforms in religious customs. The court emphasized that it's impossible to scrutinize every religious practice.

stories.title: Supreme Court to hear ED plea to cancel bail to West Bengal coal scam 'kingpin'
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear the Enforcement Directorate's plea to cancel the bail of alleged coal smuggling kingpin Anup Majee. While issuing a notice, the court noted the ED's prolonged investigation. Majee, accused in a Rs 2,700 crore scam, claims cooperation, but the ED highlights his accountant's absconding status and alleged payoffs.

stories.title: What happened between Trevv and ChudTheBuilder? Nashville confrontation turns into aggravated robbery controversy
stories.summary: ChudTheBuilder and Trevv’s online feud exploded after Trevv stole ChudTheBuilder’s hat during a public Nashville encounter on May 10, 2026. The situation quickly turned serious after accusations of aggravated robbery, weapon claims, and FBI comments surfaced online. Despite multiple viral posts and livestream reactions from both creators, no arrests or confirmed investigations have been publicly reported so far.

stories.title: Delayed by a year due to tech glitches, livestock census to be out after June
stories.summary: The 21st Livestock Census report's release has been postponed to after June due to technical issues in data compilation and validation. This quinquennial exercise, which concluded its data collection in February last year, aims to provide crucial updated figures on livestock and poultry populations for policy decisions.

stories.title: CBI busts graft ring in Punjab Vigilance Bureau
stories.summary: The CBI has uncovered a corruption ring involving the Punjab Vigilance Bureau, arresting three individuals for allegedly accepting payments to resolve official complaints. Vikas Goyal, his son Raghav Goyal, and associate Ankit Wadhwa are accused of facilitating these illicit deals. OP Rana, reader to the DG (Vigilance), is currently at large.

stories.title: Insurance pool of Rs 13,000 crore for Indian ships
stories.summary: The Indian government has launched a $1.5 billion Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool, backed by a $1.4 billion sovereign guarantee, to offer risk cover for Indian vessels on international routes, including war zones. This initiative aims to reduce shipping insurance premiums and guarantee coverage even when global insurers withdraw due to rising risks.

stories.title: CBI takes over Suvendu ex-aide murder probe
stories.summary: The CBI has filed an FIR and initiated an investigation into the murder of Chandranath Rath, former personal assistant to West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari. A seven-member SIT, led by a DIG-rank officer, has been formed to probe the case, with a meeting held at CBI headquarters to review developments and seek remand of arrested suspects.

stories.title: Mafia sold paper across states at Rs 10L-25L: Tip to Rajasthan officials ignored, 'whistleblower' emailed leaked NEET questions to NTA
stories.summary: The CBI has taken over the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak investigation after Rajasthan Police revealed a "paper leak mafia" sold leaked exam questions disguised as a guess paper for up to Rs 25 lakh. The network spanned multiple states, with a suspect detained in Nashik. The leak's origin is believed to be outside Rajasthan.

stories.title: Row over Pete Davidson's 'dark humour' on Charlie Kirk: 'He constantly makes 9/11 jokes...'
Missing Indian man Sandarsh Krishna found dead in Grand Canyon, no cause of death established yet
D4vd appears relaxed in court during murder case status hearing in Los Angeles
stories.summary: Singer D4vd, David Burke, appeared in a Los Angeles courtroom for a status hearing in his murder case. Charged in connection with the death of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez, Burke pleaded not guilty. Lawyers discussed evidence exchange and case timelines, with the next hearing set for June 17 and the preliminary hearing on June 29.

stories.title: 'Indians hiring Indians': Former Google contractor says he was asked to train his replacement
Introspect on reputational cost of aiding terror exporter Pakistan, India tells China
stories.summary: India's MEA urged China to consider the reputational damage of backing Pakistan's terrorist infrastructure, following reports of Chinese tech assistance during last year's Operation Sindoor. The ministry stated these reports corroborated existing knowledge, emphasizing that supporting such infrastructure impacts a nation's standing.

stories.title: H-1B scam: Texas company sued for selling foreign workers visas for $20,000
Starmer defiant as calls for his resignation grow, several ministers quit
Iltija Mufti blames ‘NC-BJP nexus’ for her X suspension
stories.summary: Iltija Mufti, daughter of Mehbooba Mufti, claims the National Conference, in league with the BJP, suspended her X account. She alleges this follows her criticism of the NC and the proposed removal of Urdu as a mandatory language. Her Facebook page was also recently deactivated, impacting her political outreach.

stories.title: 2 Pakistanis among 5 sent to 25-day custody for terror acts in J&K
stories.summary: Five people have been sent to judicial custody for 25 days. The group includes two Pakistani nationals. This development is part of an NIA case concerning terror activities. Earlier, a grenade and bullets were seized from a suspect in Srinagar. His interrogation led to the arrest of the other four individuals.

stories.title: Farooq joins liquor debate, says even Sheikh Abdullah didn’t favour prohibition; Mirwaiz, BJP seek ban
stories.summary: National Conference president Farooq Abdullah weighed in on a liquor ban debate in Jammu and Kashmir, citing his father's 1977 stance that revenue generation was key. He argued that prohibition wouldn't stop consumption, as people would source alcohol from outside. Abdullah also questioned critics' silence when liquor shops previously opened across the region.

stories.title: Terrorist killed, Poonch infiltration bid foiled
stories.summary: Army troops foiled an infiltration attempt in Poonch's Krishna Ghati sector on Tuesday, neutralizing one terrorist approximately 300 meters inside the Indian side of the Line of Control. This incident follows several other thwarted infiltration bids in the Jammu region in recent months, highlighting ongoing vigilance along the LoC.

stories.title: EAM’s bilateral with Iran’s Araghchi on Friday, energy disruption & connectivity on agenda
stories.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar will host his Iranian counterpart for bilateral talks focusing on energy and connectivity concerns, including stranded LPG tankers and Chabahar port operations. This meeting, occurring during the BRICS foreign ministers' gathering, aims to address regional conflicts and foster cooperation among member states.

stories.title: Sikh man in Canada says he was denied police exam over kirpan: ‘My dream was shattered’
Maya Higa receives standing ovation after becoming first Twitch streamer on TED’s main stage for animal conservation talk
stories.summary: Twitch streamer Maya Higa made history as the first to speak on the main TED stage, discussing animal conservation and Alveus Sanctuary's work. Her TED Talk, "The Wildlife Sanctuary You Can Visit from Anywhere," highlights how livestreaming can educate and inspire future conservationists globally. The event underscored the growing recognition of streaming creators in prestigious international forums.

stories.title: Quote of the day by ‘father of computer’ Charles Babbage: “For one person who is blessed with the power of invention, many will always be found who have the capacity of applying principles”
Scientists discover massive ancient ship graveyard with 150 hidden shipwrecks beneath Gibraltar waters
Foreign student enrolment at US universities falls by 20% amid ‘restrictive gov. policies’
Major ICE crackdown on 10,000 foreign students on OPT; 'fake companies' being operated from India
'Bad days for… you know who': Himanta-Suvendu bonhomie grabs attention at Assam govt swearing-in ceremony
What happened at Phuket cafe where Indian tourists fainted one by one 'for no obvious reason'? 1 dead
Quote of the day by Mother Teresa: “We do not need guns and bombs to bring peace, we need...” - the timeless lesson on peace by Saint Mother Teresa of Calcutta
'LoP is not rubber stamp': Rahul Gandhi writes to PM Modi, registers dissent with CBI chief selection process
‘I don’t trust Pakistan’: US official questions Islamabad's mediation role after Iran aircraft row, seeks alternative
stories.summary: Senator Lindsey Graham has questioned Pakistan's credibility as a mediator in US-Iran negotiations, citing reports of Iranian military aircraft using Pakistani bases. Pakistan denies these claims, stating aircraft were for diplomatic arrangements. Broader scrutiny of Pakistan's mediation role has emerged within the Trump administration due to stalled talks and Iran's response to peace proposals.

stories.title: Lorna Hajdini looks very attractive: Megyn Kelly says she believes Chirayu Rana made up the whole sexual assault lawsuit
From election drubbing to minister resignations: Why Keir Starmer is in trouble?
VP to AIIMS Graduates: AI can’t replace doctor at patient’s bedside
'He's being deported': LA restaurant owner arrested by ICE after own worker ratted him out
6 killed in Maharshtra's Sangli after Temple wall collapses due to rain
IMD launches two AI-enabled advanced weather forecast systems
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department has launched an AI-enabled monsoon forecasting system and a high-resolution rainfall forecast for Uttar Pradesh. These services will provide precise, location-specific weather information up to four weeks in advance to support farmers and various sectors. The initiative marks a shift towards impact-based forecasting.

stories.title: Not teeth, but nests: Discovery in Caribbean rodent fossils surprises archaeologists
Indian engineer charged in US for Maryland bridge crash, six construction workers were killed in 2024
Gadkari questions how much has been done to address Delhi’s pollution issue through ECC
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari questioned the effectiveness of Delhi's Environment Compensation Cess (ECC) in tackling air pollution, highlighting that its collection on national highways hinders seamless travel and damages the reputation of road infrastructure projects. He suggested alternative funding mechanisms for municipal bodies, urging the Delhi government to address the issue to alleviate commuter woes.

stories.title: 'Wife's career choice not cruelty or desertion': SC slams 'feudal' mindset of lower courts
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has set aside lower courts' regressive findings, stating a qualified woman's pursuit of her profession and child's welfare cannot be deemed cruelty or desertion. The apex court emphasised that marriage doesn't erase a woman's individuality or subordinate her identity, upholding divorce solely on irretrievable breakdown.

stories.title: Vijay's floor test splits AIADMK. Will Thalapathy go the Yediyurappa way?
'Unacceptable': Allies slam Vijay over astrologer’s appointment in CM office
Army foils infiltration bid along LoC in J&K’s Poonch; terrorist eliminated
‘India should not close doors for dialogue with Pakistan’: RSS general secretary Dattatreya Hosabale
Maharashtra MLA rides horse into municipal corporation headquarters after PM Modi’s fuel-saving appeal
NEET-UG 2026 paper leak case: Multiple arrests made across 3 states; cops uncover multi-state network of at least 45 people
If a company replaces its CEO with...: Indian-origin tech leader says he backtested billionaire Michael Milken's idea
A 160-million-year-old ‘technicolour’ dinosaur fossil discovered in China with four wings and bird-like feathers
Evening news wrap: NEET exam cancelled over paper leak; stock market crashes over 1,400 points & more
Reform UK councillor Stuart Prior quits over racist post claims days after election win
Who is Eileen Wang? California mayor resigns after working for Chinese government
NEET paper leak: Education minister avoids question, NTA gives no concrete answers, opposition corners Centre
Beyond caregiving: The unseen burden of India’s nurses
stories.summary: Indian nurses, the backbone of healthcare, are critically undervalued despite their expanded roles in patient care, crisis management, and emotional support. Facing severe shortages and overwhelming workloads, their vital contributions often go unrecognized, a situation exacerbated by the pandemic. A reckoning is needed to truly appreciate and support these frontline caregivers.

stories.title: Nine Longest Rivers Ranked: Explainer traces Nile to Congo; shows how waterways shaped civilisations
stories.summary: Rivers, nature's vital arteries, shape landscapes and history. From the Nile's ancient reign to the Amazon's immense volume, these waterways are crucial. China's Yangtze, North America's Missouri-Mississippi, Siberia's Yenisey, and the Yellow River, cradle of civilization, highlight their global significance. Russia's Ob-Irtysh, South America's Rio de la Plata, and the deep Congo further showcase their power and reach.

stories.title: Why Vijay's floor test in Tamil Nadu is really a survival test for AIADMK
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu's trust vote for CM-designate Vijay is overshadowed by a potential AIADMK rupture. Senior rebels are questioning party chief Palaniswami's leadership, accusing him of seeking an understanding with the rival DMK. This internal strife could signal the AIADMK's terminal decline as its MLAs consider shifting loyalty.

stories.title: King Cobra Capitals: 10 countries where the world’s deadliest snake thrives
'We knew already': India's 'reputation' jab at China for helping Pakistan during Operation Sindoor
'Atmosphere of unease': Oppn reacts to PM Modi's 'sudden' austerity call; Pawar, Thackeray raise red flags
stories.summary: In light of PM Modi's push for austerity amidst the escalating Middle Eastern tensions, Sharad Pawar has called for a collaborative all-party dialogue to assess potential economic repercussions. Meanwhile, Raj Thackeray raised eyebrows over the timing of this call, noting the lavish election campaigns and planned international jaunts.

stories.title: Quote of the day by Barack Obama: "You can’t let your failures define you – you have to let them teach you. You have to let them show you what to do differently next time."
One vote, two Tirupatturs: DMK flags postal ballot mix-up after HC order
stories.summary: A single vote separated winners in a Tamil Nadu election, leading to a Madras High Court order. The court barred a TVK MLA from voting in the assembly floor test due to a potential postal vote mix-up. The DMK claims a recount could equalize votes, necessitating a coin toss. The election officer cited EVM issues and postal ballot re-verification.

stories.title: Pakistan admits Iranian jets parked at its airbase, offers vague defence
UAE Central Bank grants first crypto payment licence to Crypto.com
stories.summary: The UAE has become the first country to grant a Stored Value Facilities (SVF) license to a cryptocurrency platform, allowing regulated digital asset payments. This landmark approval enables UAE residents to pay government fees using cryptocurrencies, integrating virtual asset payments into the nation's regulated financial system and bolstering its digital economy.

stories.title: Iran backs Xi Jinping’s 'four-point' Gulf security plan ahead of Trump’s China visit
stories.summary: Iran has announced its support for Chinese President Xi Jinping's four-point plan for Gulf security and regional development. This initiative, emphasizing peaceful coexistence, respect for sovereignty, adherence to international law, and balancing security with economic cooperation, comes ahead of US President Donald Trump's visit to China amid ongoing regional tensions.

stories.title: Kuwait launches new Sahel Service for flight delays, refunds and lost baggage complaints
stories.summary: Kuwait's aviation regulator has launched a new feature on the Sahel app, allowing air travelers to directly report flight delays, cancellations, and refund disputes. This digital service aims to expedite complaint handling and enhance passenger protection, simplifying communication between passengers, airlines, and authorities.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay meets AIADMK rebel leaders ahead of crucial floor test
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu faces an AIADMK internal conflict as Vijay's new government prepares for a floor test. A faction led by CV Shanmugam pledged support to Vijay, defying party directives. Agri SS Krishnamurthy warned rebel MLAs of action, while OS Manian asserted 47 MLAs back Edappadi K Palaniswami. This rift highlights deep divisions within the AIADMK following recent poll performance.

stories.summary: After winning the BJP a brute majority in the 2026 Assam assembly polls, the question now is whether Himanta Biswa Sarma stands at par with chief ministers like Yogi Adityanath and Devendra Fadnavis, who are widely regarded as disciplined Sangh loyalists and potential next generation leaders of the BJP in the post Modi-Shah era.

stories.title: 'Sanatana Dharma must be abolished': Udhayanidhi Stalin in Tamil Nadu assembly
stories.summary: Udhayanidhi Stalin, as Leader of Opposition in the Tamil Nadu assembly, reiterated his call for the eradication of Sanatan Dharma, stating it divides people. He also emphasized the primacy of the Tamil invocation song, "Tamil Thai Vazhthu," at all government events, demanding it not be sidelined.

stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi and TMC have sharply criticised the appointment of former chief electoral officer Manoj Agarwal as West Bengal's chief secretary by the new BJP government. Critics allege this rewards Agarwal for his role in the recent Assembly elections, questioning the Election Commission's neutrality and the fairness of the polls. The BJP defends the decision, citing service rules.

NEET-UG 2026 cancelled: How a 'guess paper' leak derailed the exam and what happens next
stories.summary: NEET-UG 2026 exam has been cancelled by the National Testing Agency due to a massive "guess paper" leak, impacting over 22 lakh students. The government has ordered a CBI probe into the alleged irregularities. The re-examination dates will be announced soon, with existing registrations carrying forward. This decision aims to protect the integrity of the national examination system.

stories.title: AIADMK split on the cards? Big twist looms ahead of TVK's Vijay’s crucial floor test
stories.summary: A faction of AIADMK, led by S.P. Velumani and C.V. Shanmugam, has announced support for Chief Minister Vijay's TVK government ahead of a crucial floor test. This move comes amid internal rifts within AIADMK over potential alliances, with the faction opposing any tie-up with DMK. Vijay is working to secure the required majority with support from various parties.

Etihad Chennai-Abu Dhabi flight cancelled after fire detected on wing during take-off preparations
stories.summary: An Etihad Airways flight bound for Abu Dhabi from Chennai was cancelled Monday after a fire erupted on its left wing during take-off preparations. Pilots promptly halted the aircraft, and all 280 passengers were safely evacuated without any injuries. Firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze, ensuring no further damage or casualties. The cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Etihad clarifies no fire onboard Chennai-Abu Dhabi flight after technical issue delays departure
stories.summary: Etihad Airways flight EY343 from Chennai to Abu Dhabi returned to the gate before departure due to a technical issue, not a fire as some reports suggested. Passengers were safely disembarked. The airline confirmed emergency services were activated as per protocol and the flight is expected to depart with a delay. Passenger safety remains the top priority.

stories.title: No sunset until August: Inside Alaska’s northernmost town living through 84 days of endless daylight
Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM for second term - what his cabinet looks like
stories.summary: Himanta Biswa Sarma has been sworn in as Assam's chief minister for a second term, marking a significant win for the BJP-led NDA. The grand ceremony in Guwahati was attended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other top leaders. The alliance secured a decisive victory in the recent assembly elections, reinforcing their strong hold in the northeastern state.

stories.title: FIR filed against SP MP Ajendra Singh Lodhi over derogatory remarks against PM Modi
stories.summary: An FIR is filed against Samajwadi Party MP Ajendra Singh Lodhi in Mahoba, Uttar Pradesh, for allegedly making derogatory remarks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. BJP leaders, including CM Yogi Adityanath, have strongly condemned the comments, calling them an insult to democratic values and demanding action from SP chief Akhilesh Yadav.

stories.title: 'Will ensure seamless implementation': PM Modi welcomes Ayushman Bharat, rollout of Central govt schemes in West Bengal
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed delight as West Bengal's new government, led by CM Suvendu Adhikari, began implementing central welfare schemes like Ayushman Bharat. This move fulfills a pre-election promise, aiming to provide high-quality, affordable healthcare and seamless execution of key national projects for the state's residents.

stories.title: Venugopal, Satheesan or Chennithala? Congress high command steps in as Kerala CM race hits deadlock
stories.summary: The Congress-led UDF in Kerala is struggling to name its chief ministerial candidate over a week after winning the elections. Senior leaders are in Delhi for discussions, with Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge expected to make the final decision. Ramesh Chennithala, V D Satheesan, and K C Venugopal are the frontrunners amidst internal tussle and external criticism.

Horrifying video shows moment Frontier Airlines plane hits person on Denver runway
stories.summary: A shocking incident at Denver International Airport saw a person, who allegedly breached security, fatally struck by a departing Frontier Airlines jet. The collision ignited an engine fire, forcing an emergency evacuation. Several passengers sustained minor injuries during the chaotic scene, with the NTSB now reviewing the evacuation response.

stories.title: Quest for a rare bird, a landfill visit, a deadly outbreak: How Leo Schilperoord became hantavirus 'patient zero'
stories.summary: A Dutch ornithologist, Leo Schilperoord, has been identified as patient zero in a deadly hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship. Authorities suspect he and his wife contracted the virus from rat droppings during a birdwatching trip in Argentina. The outbreak led to multiple deaths and a global health alert.

stories.title: Suvendu Adhikari aide murder case: CBI takes over probe from Bengal Police, forms 7-member team
stories.summary: The CBI has taken over the murder investigation of Chandranath Rath, an aide to Suvendu Adhikari, following a recommendation from the Bengal Police. Rath was shot dead by motorcycle-borne assailants in North 24 Parganas. Three suspects, including an alleged sharpshooter, have been arrested by the CID in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.

67% children Anaemic: ICAR develops 203 nutrient-rich crop varieties
stories.summary: Addressing widespread anemia and malnutrition, Indian agricultural scientists have developed 203 biofortified crop varieties. These nutrient-rich staples, including iron-rich rice and protein-rich wheat, aim to combat deficiencies like "hidden hunger" without altering dietary habits. This initiative, supported by the SEHAT mission, offers a sustainable, low-cost approach to improving public health through everyday food.

stories.title: 'Beyond shameless': TMC attacks BJP, EC after ex-Bengal CEO Manoj Agarwal appointed chief secretary
stories.summary: The Trinamool Congress has criticized the appointment of former Chief Electoral Officer Manoj Agarwal as West Bengal's Chief Secretary by the new BJP government. The party labeled the move "shameless," questioning the neutrality of the election process after Agarwal oversaw the recent Assembly elections.

No shortage of petro products, avoid panic but follow PM's save-fuel advice: Rajnath at iGoM meet
stories.summary: Defence minister Rajnath Singh assured citizens that India is prepared for global supply chain disruptions, with ample petroleum products and robust foreign exchange reserves. He urged fuel conservation to ease the nation's financial burden amid high international crude prices. The government is implementing measures for fuel efficiency and responsible consumption.

stories.title: HasanAbi loses his cool on Twitch after “white baby” comment sparks heated rant
stories.summary: HasanAbi sparked major online debate after angrily reacting to a Twitch viewer who called him a “white baby” during a discussion about anti-DEI movements and racism. The political streamer defended his comments by stressing his experiences as a Muslim American facing discrimination and rejected claims that he was being anti-Asian. Clips from the livestream quickly spread online, with viewers divided over whether Hasan’s emotional response was justified or an overreaction to a joke.

stories.title: Two more passengers evacuated from cruise ship test hantavirus+
stories.summary: Passengers from the MV Hondius cruise ship, affected by a deadly hantavirus outbreak, are being repatriated and quarantined globally. A French woman and an American have tested positive, with the French passenger's health worsening. Health authorities are managing the situation, emphasizing low public risk and early treatment benefits.

stories.title: Portrait looted by Nazis found in home of Dutch SS leader's family: Art sleuth
stories.summary: Two men were arrested in connection with a meticulously planned cash van robbery in Ghaziabad. The gang surveilled the vehicle for six months and rehearsed the heist four times before stealing nearly Rs 27 lakh. Police uncovered the operation after reviewing CCTV footage and identified the mastermind.

Google says criminal hackers used AI to find software flaw
stories.summary: Cybercriminals have reportedly leveraged artificial intelligence to craft a potent hacking tool capable of circumventing security measures in a widely used system administration software. Google's security team uncovered this novel threat, which exploited an unknown vulnerability to bypass multi-factor authentication. The developer was alerted and patched the flaw before it could be weaponized, marking a significant development in AI-driven cyberattacks.

stories.title: "Before Charlie was assassinated....": Candace Owens dragged into online conspiracy storm involving Charlie Kirk, Erika Kirk and Dan Bilzerian
stories.summary: Candace Owens is facing fresh online controversy after a viral social media post linked her to Dan Bilzerian while referencing Charlie Kirk, Erika Kirk and Ben Shapiro. The post made several unverified allegations and reignited debate around Owens’ past interactions with Bilzerian, including resurfaced comments about private text messages. While no evidence has supported the claims spreading online, the controversy has fuelled intense speculation, backlash and political infighting across social media platforms.

stories.summary: Opposition parties are criticizing PM Modi's call for austerity amidst the West Asia crisis, labeling it a tactic to evade accountability for economic failures. Leaders like Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge argue the PM is shifting responsibility onto the public. Akhilesh Yadav and Tejashwi Yadav also questioned the timing and perceived hypocrisy of these austerity demands.

PM Modi to depart for 5-nation tour on Friday, beginning with UAE
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi embarks on a five-nation tour starting Friday, with the UAE as his first stop. He will meet President Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan to discuss bilateral and regional issues, including energy cooperation. This visit marks his first to a Gulf country since the West Asia conflict began.

stories.title: Congress calls ex-chiefs of Kerala unit to brainstorm on next CM
stories.summary: Congress is expanding consultations to select Kerala's new chief minister, with AICC general secretary K C Venugopal and leader of opposition V D Satheesan vying for the top post. The party leadership is engaging with former state presidents and other leaders to ensure the final nominee is well-received, amid speculation and potential backlash.

stories.title: French streamer PrinceofParis allegedly exposed after Airbnb host interrupts livestream
stories.summary: French streamer PrinceofParis faced online scrutiny after an Airbnb host unexpectedly appeared during a livestream from a supposed luxury castle. The influencer abruptly ended the broadcast, fueling speculation about the authenticity of his opulent lifestyle. The incident has sparked widespread debate about the reality behind influencers' online personas, with no official statement yet released.

stories.title: Iran says ready to ‘teach a lesson’ if attacked after Trump trashes peace proposal
stories.summary: Iran's armed forces are prepared to retaliate after President Trump rejected Tehran's ceasefire proposal, escalating regional tensions. The dispute over the Strait of Hormuz, a critical oil route, has already caused significant energy supply shocks and threatens global food security, with the UN warning of a potential humanitarian crisis.

stories.title: What happened to Nikodem Czyżewski? Missing YouTuber found dead weeks later in Croatia
stories.summary: Polish YouTuber Nikodem Czyżewski, known as Lil Narcyz, has been found dead in Croatia after a month-long disappearance. The 23-year-old creator, popular for his comedy and diss tracks, was last heard from on April 8. Authorities confirmed his body's identification in Croatia, leaving fans shocked and seeking answers about his final days.

stories.title: Wrong to single out Pinarayi Vijayan for taking moral responsibility for poll defeat: CPM
stories.summary: CPM's MA Baby defended Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan, stating the party's defeat is a collective responsibility, not an individual's. He emphasized self-criticism and corrective measures for the entire leadership. Baby also expressed concern over the rise of right-wing forces and the BJP's gains in Kerala.

ED has traced direct proceeds of crime in the form of flats acquired by him in lieu of providing municipality jobs to various persons.
